jobs.description:
About Us

Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. We believe the future of medicine lies in reprogramming the body to repair itself, and we design the models and the medicines to teach it how.

Our EDEN models are trained on BaseData, the world's largest proprietary genomic dataset, with over 10B genes collected through partnerships in more than 30 countries across all seven continents. This gives our AI models access to genetic diversity that doesn't exist in public databases, and enables EDEN to design cell and gene therapies, enzymes, and peptides directly from information about a disease. Our pipeline of EDEN-designed therapeutics, beginning with in vivo cell therapy, is advancing towards clinical development.

In September 2026 we closed an oversubscribed $140M Series C led by S32, with participation from NVIDIA, Anthropic's Anthology Fund, Catalio, European Tech Collective, Firebrand River Capital, King Philanthropies, NATO Innovation Fund, NVentures (NVIDIA's venture arm), Redalpine, Rockefeller Foundation, Singular, Sovereign AI and True Ventures. We have offices and labs in London and Boston, we partner with biopharma companies and academic institutions worldwide, and our work has been recognised by Fast Company's Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Biotech, the FT-backed Sifted AI100 list of Europe's leading AI startups as well as Barclays Eagle Labs Ones to watch, AI100.

At Basecamp Research, we pride ourselves on being a lean collaborative and global team with extremely specialist and unique skills. Our biologists, engineers, ML scientists and field explorers are united by a sense of adventure and the belief that AI, biology and data, will result in new medicines for patients who have few options today.

The Role

We are seeking a highly capable and proactive Global Research Program Manager, Global Research to join our London team, embedded within the Global Research organization. You will serve as the connective tissue between departments, driving internal operational efficiency, coordinating cross-team projects, managing key partnerships, and overseeing the tools and operations that our technical teams rely on.

In this role, you will focus on optimizing processes, facilitating collaboration, goal setting/tracking and supporting the team in meeting deliverables, as well as liaising with counterparts through Partnerships with external partners.

You’ll report directly to the VP of Global Research, operating in tight dotted-line alignment with the Founding Technical Program Manager. In this capacity, you will ensure that training data is synchronised with Basecamp's frontier AI model releases. You will need to ensure that our team of field scientists and production team can focus on pioneering research and development. This is an ideal opportunity for a hands-on operator who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment where no two days are the same and wants to make a big impact on how a cutting-edge biotech company scales its operations.

Key Responsibilities

External Partnership Establishment & Efficiency

  • Manage and develop relationships with external technical and scientific partners. This includes coordinating joint projects with research collaborators, universities, sequencing vendors, and future Alliances with partners and ensuring that these partnerships are productive and aligned with our goals.

  • Own the operational coordination between the Global Research team and Basecamp's external sequencing providers (tracking sample send-offs, managing provider timelines, and maintaining clear visibility of where each batch sits in the pipeline)

  • Flag quality or capacity issues early and work with providers to resolve them before they become programme blockers

  • As sequencing volume scales, ensure the handoff between field, production, and provider is professionally managed rather than coordinated informally

Scientific Output

  • For every active collaboration or partnership: what the publication is, who leads it, where the writing time comes from, and when it submits

  • Ensure commitments made at signature: data return, capacity building, sampling deliverables

  • Coordinate publication timelines across collaborations, sequencing high-impact outputs to support Basecamp's scientific narrative and partner obligations

  • As the R+D team builds out protocols and finalises methodology, ensure those are rolled out to partner labs and that data is received within expected timelines

  • Link targeted expedition outputs to downstream R+D planning

Cross-Functional Coordination & Process Improvement

  • Work across Global Research, Data Science, and Science teams to plan and execute cross-functional initiatives, especially in the context of generating data for foundational model development.

  • Work in close partnership with the Founding TPM to ensure teams are aware and in-sync with each other’s work and we work as one team to achieve our mission as fast as possible.

  • Identify bottlenecks and opportunities for improvement in internal workflows; implement new processes or tools to boost operational efficiency without adding bureaucratic overhead

  • Promote effective knowledge sharing across teams: ensuring learnings, best practices, and project updates are documented in a lightweight, accessible way

  • Tooling & Infrastructure Oversight: Oversee the selection, implementation, and optimization of the software tools and platforms used by our technical teams (e.g. project management systems, lab management systems & data systems). Make sure our Production and R+D teams have the right tools and partners with both the Data & Science team to prevent operational fragmentation or parallel status reporting.

Required Skills and Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in programme or project management within a scientific, research, or biotech organisation. You have coordinated complex, multi-workstream programmes with multiple stakeholders and delivered them

  • A track record of holding scientists, field teams, and partner organisations accountable to timelines and deliverables without damaging relationships

  • Exceptional organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. You naturally build the process that prevents the problem rather than solving it repeatedly

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; you can produce a clear status report, a partner update, and an internal escalation without needing someone else to translate

  • Experience managing relationships with external vendors or partners, ideally in scientific or technical contexts: comfortable evaluating services, tracking SLAs, and keeping providers accountable

  • Scientific literacy: you don't need to be in the lab, but you should be familiar enough with genomics, sequencing workflows, and data pipelines to have informed discussions and spot where things are going wrong

  • Proactive, resourceful, and independent: you spot issues before they escalate and rally the right people to fix them

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid change; Basecamp is scaling quickly and the playbook is still being written

Advantageous Skills and Experience

  • Experience at a research funder (Wellcome, Gates Foundation, CGIAR) or a research organisation (ARIA, Crick, Sanger, EMBL) where scientific deliverables are tracked against contractual commitments

  • Familiarity with access and benefit-sharing frameworks, DSI governance, or international biodiversity research partnerships

  • Experience coordinating scientific publications across multi-institutional collaborations

  • Master's or PhD in life sciences, computational sciences, or a related field

  • Prior experience at a high-growth startup or in scaling operations for a technical team

What we offer in return

  • Impactful Mission: This is a rare chance to do work that genuinely matters. You'll join a talented, fast-moving team, access unique biological datasets at scale, and see your contributions shape real breakthroughs in AI and curative therapeutics..

  • Collaborative Culture: You'll be surrounded by world-class engineers, scientists, and researchers who care deeply about their work and about each other. With offices in London and Boston, we've built a flexible, cross-functional environment where personal development and real ownership aren't just talking points.

  • High Growth: We truly believe in investing our top talent, we make coaching available to team members during steep growth journeys and we have twice yearly promotion opportunities. People who are really successful here own it and go directly to solve problems at pace and we ensure reward increases with impact.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: We've built a benefits package people value. That means competitive salary, equity, and private healthcare with no medical history exclusions so strong that means most employees' family members opt into our plan over their own. We also offer Carrot Fertility with IVF stipend, salary sacrifice pension, bike to work scheme, life insurance, and more.

Apply for the job

Do you want to join our team as our new Global Research Program Manager? Then we'd love to hear about you!

jobs.description:
Über ]init[

Du möchtest die Gesellschaft von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei ]init[ richtig. Denn unsere digitalen Lösungen sind für Menschen gemacht und haben gesellschaftliche Relevanz. Klingt spannend? Dann steig ein und arbeite gemeinsam mit über 1.400 ]init[s in interdisziplinären Teams an unseren sieben Standorten – oder flexibel von überall in Deutschland aus.


Deine Mission bei ]init[

Du willst Digitalisierung dort vorantreiben, wo sie gesellschaftlich wirklich zählt? Als Senior Project Manager (all genders) gestaltest und steuerst du anspruchsvolle digitale Verwaltungsprojekte rund um Migration & Inneres. Du bringst Kund:innen, Fachlichkeit und Technologie zusammen und machst aus komplexen Anforderungen digitale Lösungen, die in der Praxis funktionieren.


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Du realisierst anspruchsvolle IT- und Digitalisierungsprojekte von gesellschaftlicher Relevanz mit besonderem Fokus auf die Fachthemen Migration & Inneres – agil oder hybrid.
  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Projekte über die gesamte Projektlaufzeit und steuerst Scope, Time, Budget, Qualität und Risiken.
  • Du arbeitest mit interdisziplinäre Projektteams, in unterschiedlichen technologischen Kontexten – von digitalen Verwaltungsleistungen und Fachanwendungen über Content- und Formular-Management-Systeme bis hin zu individuellen IT-Lösungen zusammen und sorgst für eine strukturierte und verlässliche Zusammenarbeit innerhalb des Projekts.
  • Als zentrale Schnittstelle koordinierst du interne und externe Stakeholder und arbeitest eng mit unseren Kund:innen aus der öffentlichen Verwaltung zusammen. Gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Teams übersetzt du die Anforderungen unserer Kund:innen in tragfähige IT-Lösungen und digitale Prozesse und begleitest deren Umsetzung von der Konzeption bis zum erfolgreichen Go-live.
  • Du begleitest unsere Kund:innen bei Fragestellungen rund um die digitale Transformation und erkennst dabei auch Potenziale für die Weiterentwicklung bestehender Projekte und Lösungen.


Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projektmanagement von  Entwicklungs- oder Digitalisierungsprojekten und kannst Projekte eigenständig und Ende-zu-Ende steuern.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Steuerung interdisziplinärer Projektteams und übernimmst sicher Verantwortung für Scope, Budget, Time,  Qualität und Risiken.
  • Idealerweise bringst du bereits Erfahrung mit Digitalisierungsprojekten der öffentlichen Verwaltung und/oder einen fachlichen Bezug zu den Themen Migration & Inneres mit.
  • Du kennst und schätzt die Zusammenarbeit mit externen Kund:innen und verstehst Projektmanagement als kundenorientierte Delivery-Rolle und bewegst dich mit deinem Kommunikationsgeschick souverän auf unterschiedlichen Ebenen der Projektorganisation.
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit agilen und/oder klassischen Projektmethoden. Erfahrung mit skalierten agilen Vorgehensweisen oder hybriden Projekt-Set-ups ist ein Plus.
  • Idealerweise verfügst du über eine relevante Projektmanagement- oder Agile-Zertifizierung, z. B. PRINCE2, PMI, Scrum PSM/PSPO
  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium bildet die fachliche Grundlage für deine Tätigkeit bei uns.
  • Du bringst sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit.


Das bieten wir dir

  • Because we care: 30 Urlaubstage und Workation innerhalb der EU schaffen Freiraum für Erholung und neue Perspektiven. So lassen sich Beruf und Privatleben gut miteinander verbinden.
  • Work with us: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten und Teilzeitmodelle ermöglichen dir, Arbeit und Alltag passend zu gestalten – immer abgestimmt mit deinem Team und deinen Projekten.
  • Learn with us: Mit der ]init[ Academy, Trainings, Zertifizierungen und bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch entwickelst du dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Grow with us: Profitiere von bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch und entwickle dich gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg:innen kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Ride with us: JobRad, ÖPNV-Zuschuss und weitere Mobility Benefits unterstützen dich dabei, flexibel und nachhaltig unterwegs zu sein.
  • Start with us: Welcome Week, strukturiertes Onboarding und Patenschaften sorgen für einen gelungenen Einstieg und helfen dir, schnell im Team und deinen Projekten anzukommen.


Werde Teil des Teams

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft – in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, remote oder im Office.
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.
Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit sind für uns selbstverständlich. Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung und Gleichstellung begrüßen wir ausdrücklich.
 
Da uns und unseren Kund:innen Sicherheit wichtig ist, kann je nach Position nach einer Zusage eine vertrauliche Sicherheitsüberprüfung erforderlich sein.

Anne Kroll

jobs.title: Senior/Staff ML Scientist - Bidding & Optimization (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile app growth and monetization, challenging the status quo of adtech by redefining how apps acquire users and generate revenue. Our two products, Playtime Arcade and adjoe Ads, sit at opposite ends of the mobile advertising spectrum: rewarded engagement and programmatic in-app advertising. Together they run on 13% of the world’s smartphones, connecting advertisers, publishers, and hundreds of millions of users, with one goal: making mobile advertising work better for everyone in the ecosystem.

Next-Gen Machine Intelligence for Auctions & Real-Time Bidding

The Data Science Research team builds the foundational algorithms that govern real-time bidding, budget pacing, and allocation mechanics across our products. Operating as a horizontal deep-tech layer, the team leverages advanced AI—specifically reinforcement learning, objective-based optimization, and control theory—to deliver critical systems that perfectly harmonize advertiser ROI, platform health, and user relevance. These frameworks scale adjoe’s products beyond standard industry limitations, utilizing behavioral and transactional data from over 770 million users.

The team operates at the intersection of high-load, low-latency engineering, auction mechanism design, and state-of-the-art machine learning. Acting as the company’s internal science bar raiser, they translate complex business constraints into mathematical objectives. The stack is optimized for high throughput: PyTorch for training deep learning and RL models, distributed architectures for large-scale Bayesian inference, Trino and Athena for querying massive user-behavior data lakes, and dedicated GPU infrastructure. The full lifecycle of these AI capabilities is owned by the team—from academic paper translation and offline prototyping to deploying core algorithmic frameworks built to sustain ultra-low latency, real-time production environments evaluating tens of thousands of requests per second.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

  • PhD or equivalent research depth, with a production track record. You have a PhD in CS, Statistics, Math, or Physics (or an MSc with extensive industry research) and a track record of peer-reviewed publications in fields like Computational Advertising, Auction Theory, Mechanism Design, or Game Theory. You’ve spent 4+ years optimizing complex systems through automated algorithms in AdTech, marketplaces, or high-frequency trading.

  • You translate research into production, not just prototypes. You distill SOTA research into robust, production-ready code optimized for sub-millisecond latency. At adjoe, that means architecting sophisticated auction mechanics, real-time bidding engines, and allocation algorithms serving millions of requests across a stack built on 770 million users.

  • Deep expertise in Reinforcement Learning and Optimization. You have hands-on, deep theoretical and technical expertise in objective-based optimization, control theory, or RL applied specifically to bidding, pricing strategy, and budget pacing under extreme production constraints.

  • Mastering high-dimensional data at scale. Large-scale Bayesian inference and handling sparse, high-dimensional advertising data are core to your work. You are strongly proficient in Python and related stacks, and know exactly how to architect scalable data pipelines to feed real-time optimization models.

  • Raises the technical bar around them. You lead architectural debates, collaborate tightly with Product Managers and Engineers to map business goals to mathematical objective functions, mentor junior scientists, and drive the team’s research direction without needing a roadmap handed to you.

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

What’s in It for You?

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

  • Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

  • Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

  • Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

  • Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.

  • Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Carpool Experience
jobs.description:
About BlaBlaCar

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely.


The role

Carpool Experience covers everything between two members once they have found each other: agreeing on the trip, talking, meeting up, and building trust.

Vision: a carpool experience that feels easy and safe for passengers and drivers, from the first hello to the final goodbye.

Mission: make it simple for members to talk, negotiate, meet up and trust each other.

You own six product areas, used by millions of members every month:

  • Negotiation. Before booking, passengers can ask the driver for a detour, a lower price or another special request, and add a tip. Drivers accept, decline or make a counter-offer. It launched in France in 2025 and went worldwide in 2026. It is still a new product: what it should become, and how far it can go, is yours to figure out.

  • Messaging. The chat between drivers and passengers. Next up: Group Chat, and catching up with market standards.

  • GPS Tracking: both the technical capability as well as features it enables (including sharing ETA on the map, ESC bonus in Spain among others)

  • Post-Carpool ride XP (claims, ratings etc.). How members build trust in each other. This includes AI Ratings Summary, BlaBlaCar's first consumer-facing GenAI feature.

  • Communication Service and contact preferences. The platform that sends every push notification, email, SMS and WhatsApp message across the company, plus the settings members use to choose what they receive.

  • Marketing tools. Braze and deeplinks, used by the CRM and marketing teams.

This is a key scope, and you own its strategy. That comes with high exposure: you present to the Executive Committee every two weeks. You get a direct say in company decisions, and you are expected to bring clear thinking and solid arguments to the table.


Your Responsibilities
  • Set the direction. Build the vision and strategy for your scope, turn it into ambitious OKRs, and get leadership behind them.
  • Own the numbers. Know your business metrics, reliability targets and costs in detail. Review them every month and act on what they tell you, without being asked.
  • Shape the future of Negotiation. Work out where its real value is for members and for BlaBlaCar, decide how it should evolve (new use cases such as negotiation after booking, conversion, usage), and prove the impact on passengers (PAX) and GMV.
  • Ship the next member interactions: Group Chat, live location for both drivers and passengers, and the next version of the Communication Service.
  • Run experiments and rollouts with discipline. Run A/B tests and country-by-country launches with decision rules set in advance, together with Legal, Privacy and country leads.
  • Hold your own with the ExCo. Every two weeks, present progress, decisions and trade-offs to the Executive Committee. Take a clear position, defend it, and change it when the evidence calls for it.
  • Raise the bar of the product team. Share your methods, coach other PMs, and challenge how we work.

    • Your Qualifications

  • You take full ownership of your product's outcomes. You go to the data with a question, spot what changed before anyone flags it, and act on it. You don't wait for direction: you come with a clear proposal, build it with your team and stakeholders, and follow through.

  • You turn many signals into one clear strategy. You combine data, user research, market moves and tech constraints into one view of where the product should go, not a list of projects. You can explain it in two minutes, it holds from one conversation to the next, and you cut complexity to get more done with less.

  • You understand the business, not just the product. You know how BlaBlaCar makes money and where your scope fits in. You can give your key metrics, their current level and what moves them without opening a dashboard. You talk about impact on PAX, GMV and costs as naturally as about features.

  • You have strong opinions and an open mind. You take a clear position without waiting for leadership to take theirs, back it with evidence, and change your view openly when a better argument comes along.

  • You communicate at a leadership level. You have already owned discussions with C-level or ExCo on strategy and trade-offs, and come out with decisions. You adapt your message to each audience and resolve conflicts constructively.

  • Baseline:

  • You have 5+ years of product management, ideally on consumer apps, including at least one scope you owned end to end over several quarters with measurable business impact. 

  • You use AI tools in your daily work. 

  • You are fluent in English.

    • If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, tell us why you’d still be a great fit for this role in your application!


    What we have to offer
  • 2 to 3 days at the office per week
  • 4 additional weeks on top of legal maternity/paternity leaves
  • 50% healthcare coverage (Alan)
  • Financial support for home office equipment
  • Minimum 25 days holiday per year
  • Local meal plan policy (Swile card)
  • 50% transportation paid (Forfait Mobilité Durable)
  • Free unlimited carpooling & bus rides

jobs.title: Product Design Manager
jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

We're looking for an experienced design manager to lead our Product Design team.

This is a management role. Your job is to develop designers, raise the quality of the work, and make sure design has real influence on where the product goes. It is not a player-coach role, and it is not a step up for a strong IC looking for their first management position. We need someone who has already managed product designers and can do it well from day one.

n8n is a powerful, flexible technical tool, which means the problems your team tackles are complex. Design decisions have to account for diverse user workflows, technical constraints, and how changes ripple across the whole platform. You'll need enough craft depth to recognise excellent work, challenge it constructively, and help designers get better. The team needs a manager whose design judgment they trust.

You'll manage a team spanning product designers, design engineers and user researchers at a range of seniority levels, working across our product areas. You'll work alongside our other design manager. You'll report to our VP of Product until our Head of Design joins the team. That search is running now.

More than 80% of workflows built on n8n involve AI agents, and we're widening from a developer audience to a broader set of builders. That shift is the central design problem here, and your team is at the centre of it.

🎯 Your main goal is to build a Product Design team that consistently produces excellent work and shapes how n8n's product evolves. Here's what that involves:


Lead and develop the team

  • Run regular, high-quality 1:1s and coach designers, design engineers and researchers across different levels.

  • Own performance management: evidence-based reviews, honest feedback, and real support for anyone who isn't where they need to be.

  • Help people understand what's expected at their level and what growth looks like, evolving our progression framework for Product Design.

  • Hire excellent designers as the team grows, and broaden the range of backgrounds and perspectives on the team.

Raise the design bar

  • Set and hold a high standard across problem framing, user understanding, interaction design, information architecture and visual craft.

  • Facilitate design critiques and reviews that measurably improve the work, and help designers think beyond the feature in front of them.

  • Develop designers' judgment and autonomy rather than becoming the final approval layer for every decision.

Own the whole product experience

  • Keep a holistic view across features and product areas, identifying inconsistencies, recurring UX problems, and opportunities for more coherent patterns.

  • Work with the team to address fragmentation systematically rather than feature by feature.

Make design a real partner

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership so design contributes early to problem definition and product direction, not late to execution.

  • Help designers influence product decisions through strong reasoning rather than positional authority.

  • Improve how the team works across critique, collaboration, decision-making and knowledge sharing, introducing structure where it helps the team scale and resisting process that slows things down.

How much of this is hands-on?

Worth being direct, because it's the question every good candidate asks. This is a management role: developing designers, raising the bar, and making design count in product decisions is the job, and that's where your time goes.

You'll stay close to the craft in critiques, in reviews and in the detail of the work, and you'll occasionally pick up design work yourself. When that happens it sits outside the squads and varies with the period: an exploratory concept, a gap during someone's leave, a problem that needs a first pass. It is not a 50/50 split, and if what you want is to keep a squad's worth of delivery alongside managing the team, this isn't the role.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 👥 Proven design management: You've managed product designers in a product-led technology company for 3+ years, with a team of five or more. This is not a first management role.

  • 🧭 Running a team well: You've run effective 1:1s, evidence-based performance reviews and difficult feedback conversations, including with people who weren't performing. You've built or improved a career progression framework for designers, and you're comfortable with the administrative side of managing a team rather than treating it as overhead.

  • 📈 Growing people: You coach and mentor, you run critique that changes the work, and you can point to specific designers who got measurably better or grew in scope while reporting to you.

  • 🎨 Design taste and judgment: Your own craft is strong enough that designers trust your read on quality, you can articulate what separates adequate design from excellent design, and you'll step into the work directly when the situation calls for it.

  • 🎯 Hiring: You've hired designers consistently well, you know where good design talent is and how to attract it, and you can tell the difference quickly.

  • 🤖 AI fluency: You use AI tools hands-on in your own work and in how your team designs, and you have an informed view on designing AI-enabled products. AI agents are the product here, so this one is not optional.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🛠️ Technical products: You've managed design teams in B2B SaaS, developer tools, workflow automation or similarly technical products.

  • 🧠 Technical mindset: You don't need to write code, but genuine curiosity about what's happening underneath (APIs, webhooks, data structures, how workflows actually execute) earns you credibility with engineers here.

  • 👩‍💻 Designing for developers: You've designed products for developers, technical operators or other sophisticated users.

  • 🔭 Systems view: You can step back from individual projects to spot patterns and UX problems across a broader product experience.

  • 🤝 Influence without authority: You bring Product and Engineering peers with you through reasoning rather than positional authority.

  • 📊 Scaling teams: You've grown a design team through a period of rapid company growth.

  • 🌍 Distributed teams: You've managed designers in remote-first or highly distributed organisations.

  • 🔓 Open source: You've worked on open-source or community-driven products.

  • 🌱 Inclusive hiring: You've meaningfully broadened the diversity of a design team through how you hire.

Our hiring process

We'll tell you the whole shape of it upfront, and there's very little homework.

  1. Screening call with our recruiter. 45 minutes, no prep.

  2. Leading designers with the hiring manager, 75 minutes. You'll present for 20 minutes on a team you built, grew or turned around. Reuse existing material; it shouldn't take more than two or three hours. We don't need case studies of your own design work.

  3. Live critique and coaching, 60 minutes. We'll send you a real piece of n8n design work 24 hours ahead. You'll critique it, then have a coaching conversation with the designer who made it. No preparation beyond reading it and trying the product.

  4. Conversation with our VP of Product, and a culture call with Jan, our CEO. 45 minutes each, same day where we can.

  5. Meet two or three of the designers you'd be managing. Not scored; it's for you as much as for us.

We'll also ask for two references, one of them a former direct report. A portfolio is welcome if you have one, though we know not every design manager keeps theirs current.

Why join us?

At n8n, your work won't disappear into a slide deck. You'll lead design for a product that hundreds of thousands of builders use to automate real work, sitting right where developer tools, AI agents and no-code interaction models meet. The design problems are genuinely hard and largely unsolved.

You're inheriting an established team with strong designers, not building from zero, and there's real room to shape how the team coaches, critiques, grows and works with Product and Engineering, rather than inheriting a rigid design organisation. You'll stay close enough to the craft to influence quality directly, while your main job is making the designers around you better.

You'll join a fast-growing, Europe remote-first company where autonomy, experimentation, and craft matter, at the point where n8n is scaling from a beloved open-source project into a major B2B platform. Design's contribution to product thinking is established here, and has a long way still to run.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now and help us build the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

  • Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

  • Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.

* Country-specific details are provided in your contract.

jobs.description:
Build something monumental for Healthcare!

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

About the Role

You care about making complex systems actually work, not just in theory, but in practice - across teams, stakeholders, and real-world constraints. In previous roles, you were likely the person who brought clarity to messy situations: aligning engineers, partners, and product teams to get things shipped.

At Tandem, you'll drive how our platform connects with the external systems used across French and European healthcare - owning and driving some of the most critical technical initiatives we have. You'll be based in our France office, working alongside the local team, in close collaboration with our central Integrations team in Stockholm. A big part of the role is deeply understanding both sides: the capabilities and constraints of external systems, and those of our own platform. From that understanding, you'll find ways to integrate them and shape concrete proposals for how integrations should work, together with external partners.

You move fast, but not carelessly. You know how to break down complex problems, prioritize what matters, and keep momentum across multiple workstreams. You're comfortable going deep technically when needed, understanding APIs, data flows, and system constraints, while still keeping the bigger product picture in mind.


This is a high-impact role where you'll not only deliver projects, but shape how we build and scale technical products at Tandem.


What You'll Do

  • Lead integration work with external partners and healthcare systems, ensuring high-quality, scalable implementations.

  • Map external systems against our own platform and propose concrete integration designs to external partners.

  • Act as the central point of coordination between engineering, partnerships, and external stakeholders, bridging the local team in France and the integrations team in Stockholm.

  • Translate complex technical requirements into clear priorities, plans, and deliverables.

  • Work closely with engineers to understand APIs, data models, and system architecture, and ensure solutions are robust and aligned with our platform.

  • Identify bottlenecks, manage dependencies, and keep projects moving at high velocity.

  • Build and improve how we work - establishing processes, templates, and frameworks for integrations and technical delivery.

  • Ensure strong visibility across stakeholders - tracking progress, surfacing risks, and communicating clearly.

jobs.description:
Über die Position

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus

Connected Growers entwickelt June: Die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche.

Dafür suchen wir einen Product Manager (m/w/d) für unseren Bereich Grower Experience, der gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design unsere Anwendung für Gartenbaubetriebe weiterentwickelt.

Deine Rolle bei June

Als Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Produktentwicklung unserer Anwendung für Gärtner*innen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO.

Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. Du entwickelst daraus technische Lösungen und Standards für die Branche. 

Du definierst relevante KPIs für deinen Produktbereich und misst den Erfolg deiner Arbeit konsequent an ihnen.


Anforderungen

Was du mitbringst

  • Mindestens 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-Softwareprodukten.

  • Erfahrung im eigenständigen Führen von User Interviews, Bereitschaft zu unregelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Besuchen bei Gärtner*innen. (Führerschein erforderlich) 

  • Kenntnisse gängiger Tracking- und Analytics-Tools.

  • Exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation (Roadmaps, PRDs).

  • AI-Erfahrung am Puls der Zeit: Du bist bei neuen Entwicklungen up-to-date und findest wege, wie du AI für Deine Arbeit und eingebettet im Softwareteam effizient nutzen kannst.

  • Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch.

Das wäre ein Plus

  • Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel. 

  • Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung.


Aufgabenbereich

Was du bei uns bewegst

  • Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience.

  • Du sprichst wöchentlich eigenständig mit unseren Gärtner*innen, baust Beziehungen zu ihnen auf und triffst die Betriebe in unregelmäßigen Abständen auch vor Ort.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst.

  • Du verstehst und artikulierst den Business Value deiner Produktentscheidungen, u. a. über KPI-Frameworks, und nutzt Tracking- und Analytics-Daten, um Annahmen zu validieren und Produktentscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen.

  • Du kommunizierst Roadmaps, PRDs und Produktentscheidungen klar und überzeugend – schriftlich wie mündlich.

  • Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich in deinem Alltag – für Prototyping, eigene Datenanalysen und einen effizienten, AI-gestützten Produktentwicklungsprozess gemeinsam mit deinem Engineering-Team.

Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf unser Produkt, unsere Kunden und den Erfolg von June.


So arbeiten wir

Unsere Produktteams verantworten ihre Bereiche vollständig: von der Produktstrategie über User Research und Priorisierung bis hin zum Release und den kommerziellen KPIs ihres Bereichs.
Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering übernehmt ihr Verantwortung für den Erfolg eures Produktbereichs und arbeitet kontinuierlich daran, ihn zu verbessern.
Wir sprechen regelmäßig mit unseren Kunden, besuchen sie vor Ort und testen unsere Lösungen gemeinsam mit ihnen. Wir glauben, dass gute Produktentscheidungen nur entstehen, wenn man die Probleme der Nutzer wirklich versteht.
Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, treffen Entscheidungen früh und passen sie an, wenn neue Erkenntnisse entstehen. Wir haben starke Meinungen, halten aber nicht dogmatisch an ihnen fest. Verantwortung endet bei uns nicht mit dem Release.

Was dich erwartet

  • Die Möglichkeit, Produktverantwortung für einen der zentralen Bereiche von June zu übernehmen.

  • Die Chance, den europäischen Gartenbau grundlegend zu verändern

  • Ein erfahrenes Design, Product und Engineering-Team an deiner Seite.

  • Großer Gestaltungsspielraum für Produktstrategie und Roadmap.

  • Viel Verantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege.

  • Modernes, AI-gestütztes Arbeiten im gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess.

  • Die Möglichkeit, unsere Produktkultur aktiv mitzugestalten.

  • Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei den Gärtner*innen vor Ort.

jobs.description:
🏨 The Company

Resilience Care is a leading medical remote monitoring player and a clinical research partner. Founded in France in 2021, our mission is simple: improve patient care.
We build remote monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology and psychiatry, powered by ePRO collection and AI techniques. Our platform helps care teams detect side effects early for continuous and proactive care, while our patient app helps people track and manage symptoms with tailored resources.
Our solutions optimize care pathways, enrich continuous patient understanding, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring and detailed analysis of real-world data. Today, our solutions are deployed in routine care for 35,000 patients across 200+ healthcare institutions, and also support around twenty academic and industry clinical studies.
We put data at the service of care and therapeutic innovation, with the ambition to enable every patient to benefit from personalized medicine.

📝 Your Role

In a nutshell

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own initiatives end to end across our three therapeutic areas: Oncology, Gastroenterology and Psychiatry. You will work at the intersection of field needs, clinical expertise, technology and business, with a clear objective: turn a real problem into a delivered and measurable product response.

You will join a fully remote, distributed Product team and report directly to the VP Product. Your mandate will evolve with team priorities: you will not be permanently attached to one business unit or a fixed backlog.

Your impact

  • Deliver a first initiative end to end within three months of joining.

  • Connect every initiative to a measurable outcome such as adoption, field impact, efficiency or business contribution.

  • Build effective collaboration with Medical, Tech, Revenue, KAM, Patient Care and QARA.

  • Use AI to accelerate discovery, prototyping and execution without lowering quality standards.

  • Create at least one AI tool or skill reused by another person or team within your first six months.

Your day-to-day work

  • Lead field discovery and turn needs into clear product problems.

  • Prototype with AI, specify solutions and work with Tech through production release.

  • Collaborate with Medical on clinical validation and with QARA on quality and compliance.

  • Measure adoption and impact after delivery.

  • Keep Product documentation, the semantic library and required QMS evidence current.

✨ Your Team

You will join a Product team with complementary backgrounds, working closely with Medical and Tech as one R&D organisation. The team operates across therapeutic areas: mandates evolve with priorities, and each Product Manager remains accountable for the outcome of their initiatives.

The role is fully remote, like the rest of the team, with an opportunity to meet in person during the annual company offsite.


👤 Candidate Profile

⚙️ You are the right person if you know how to

  • Turn clinical, field or business needs into clear and measurable product problems.

  • Lead discovery, prototyping, specification, delivery and impact measurement.

  • Use AI in practical ways to accelerate Product work.

  • Align Medical, Tech, commercial, operations and quality teams.

  • Manage by outcomes, connecting adoption, user impact and business priorities.

🙂 You are the right person if you have

  • Strong end-to-end ownership.

  • Clear and concise communication across different audiences.

  • A collaborative mindset and the habit of seeking and sharing expertise.

  • The ability to make trade-offs and their consequences visible.

  • High standards for quality, documentation and measurement.

📃 You are the right person if you have already

  • Built at least seven years of Product Management experience.

  • Shipped an AI-enabled product, tool or skill used in real conditions beyond a prototype or proof of concept.

  • Owned complex initiatives from discovery through impact measurement.

  • Worked with multidisciplinary teams in healthcare or across healthcare systems.

  • Used English fluently in a professional setting.

It is a plus if you have experience with regulated products, a quality management system or hospital information systems.

💛 Why join us?

  • Work on products connecting care-team needs, patient experience and technology.

  • Own initiatives end to end rather than only managing a backlog.

  • Embed AI into everyday Product practice and share what you build.

  • Join a distributed team where decisions and learning are documented.

  1. Screening with Talent Acquisition Elena — 20 minutes.

  4. Final panel — four 30-minute interviews with the CMO, a Product Manager, a General Manager and a Head of Business Unit. The panel also assesses culture fit and professional English.

jobs.title: Platform Product Manager - SAP (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About Qorelo

Almost every large company in the DACH region is facing the same task: the transformation to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point — nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.

That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI layer for S/4HANA transformation: we read code, processes and documentation, make the existing landscape transparent, and deliver the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards — including in day-to-day operations, long after the system integrators have moved on.

We've raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies, including Mercedes-Benz.

The role

You'll be the person who decides what we build next, and why. You'll lead our two solution architects — the people who carry our SAP domain depth — and turn what they know about real transformation projects into a roadmap our engineers can ship. You'll work in close collaboration with our Head of Product Design and the engineering team, and you'll spend real time with the people who use the product: consultants, IT leads, and transformation teams inside enterprise clients.

This is an early-stage PM role in the full sense: strategy and backlog, customer discovery and acceptance criteria, the big roadmap call and the unglamorous ticket. You'll do IC work alongside the thinking, and your decisions will show up in the product within weeks, running inside some of the largest SAP landscapes in Europe.

What you'll own

  • The product roadmap. You prioritize what our AI agents learn to do next across the transformation lifecycle — from fit-to-standard analysis to post-go-live evolution — and you can defend every call with customer evidence.

  • The solution architects. You lead our two SAs directly, turning their module knowledge and project scar tissue into product requirements engineering can build against.

  • Discovery with real users. Consultants and enterprise IT teams use Qorelo inside live transformation programmes. You sit with them, watch where the product wins and where it fails, and bring that back as decisions, not just notes.

  • The bridge between domain and build. SAP depth on one side, an AI-native engineering team on the other. You speak enough of both languages that nothing gets lost in translation — and you work with our Head of Product Design so what we ship is usable by SAP people, not just correct.

  • Shipping. Specs, acceptance criteria, tradeoffs, cut lines. Features reach real users on real landscapes, and you own whether they landed.

What you need

  • 4+ years hands-on SAP experience, functional or product side — S/4HANA transformation, fit-to-standard, and module-level depth in at least one core area like FI, SD, or PP

  • 2+ years product experience: you've owned a roadmap, prioritized with engineering, and shipped features to real users — title doesn't matter, ownership does

  • Understanding of the SAP transformation lifecycle (Discover → Prepare → Explore → Realize) deep enough to talk credibly to consultants and IT leads at enterprise clients

  • Strong AI curiosity — you've actually built or worked with LLM/agentic tooling, not just read about it

  • Comfort in an early-stage environment: ambiguity, speed, IC work alongside strategy

  • Fluent English; German is a plus for our DACH client base

You might be a fit if

  • You've sat inside an S/4HANA programme and thought "half of this should be software" — and can name which half

  • You've been the person consultants trust on module questions and the person engineers trust to write a clear spec

  • You've built something with LLMs — a prototype, an internal tool, an agent — and formed opinions about where they break

  • You want your product decisions to run inside DAX 40 landscapes within weeks, not sit in a committee for quarters

What we offer

  • Real ownership. Meaningful equity and a direct hand in the company's direction, not just your backlog. We're looking for people who want to shape a company, not join one.

  • Competitive salary, benchmarked for senior product talent in Berlin.

  • The problems. Fortune 500 and DAX 40 production landscapes, including Mercedes-Benz. Your roadmap decisions run at the core of companies most PMs only read about.

  • The team. Short paths, fast decisions, and a direct line to the engineers and architects who build what you define.

  • 25 days paid vacation plus German public holidays.

  • Company offsites with the whole team.

  • An office at the Wasserturm in Prenzlauer Berg. This role works from the office — product decisions here happen in the room with the architects and engineers. The fridge is stocked.

  • Wellhub membership, top-tier equipment and access to the latest AI tools.

Hiring process

  1. Intro call with Reza (30 min)

  2. Deep dive on your SAP and product background with Louis, our CEO (60 min)

  3. Practical case: product exercise with the team, including our solution architects

  4. Offer

jobs.description:
What we offer

  • Work in an international, agile and ambitious team creating the future of autonomous systems
  • Grow your career in a expanding and ambitious engineering team
  • Build innovative products using state-of-the-art technologies in AI, robotics, and autonomy 
  • Benefit from a steep learning curve and continuous development
  • Enjoy team events and a strong, collaborative culture


Your mission

Join Autonomous Teaming Solutions and build next-generation autonomous robotic systems for demanding real-world environments. You will take end-to-end technical ownership and responsibility of a mission-critical robotics product where perception, system performance, and reliability directly impact operational success. 

As Principal Engineer, you carry overall technical responsibility. You have the final word on architecture, integration and deployment - and you carry the consequences when the system fails. No project manager above you. You decide, you deliver. You work directly with company leadership, not as a career step, but because you are the deepest technically. Your place is still in the team: building, not reporting.

  • You own a complex autonomous system end-to-end - from architecture to field deployment.
  • You build yourself solutions - every day, in the code, next to your team. With us, leading means going first.
  • You are the tiebreaker on technical decisions across all subsystems.
  • You cut whatever does not pay into the next milestone - before you optimize.
  • You test in the field, with measurable and clear pass/fail criteria.


Your profile

  • You are a builder. You have already put things into the world. Systems, products, projects with real users. Not just planned, not conceptualized: built.
  • You have built something of your own before: a company, a product, a project with no one standing behind you. You know what real responsibility feels like. 
  • Deep knowledge in real-time embedded systems, sensor fusion or perception. Proven by systems that run and make a difference. 
  • You have taken something from zero to running hard- and software solutions. Solely responsible, with numbers to show for it.
  • C++ and ROS2 under a latency budget is your terrain.
  • Your first reaction to a new requirement is to ask whether it can be dropped.
  • You have made engineers better by building next to them and coach them.
  • You build in your own time too, because you cannot do otherwise.


What else

  • Citizenship of a NATO member country or close ally.


Why us?

How we work

Clear ownership, everything else is bureaucracy. Every system has exactly one owner with the final word. No V-model, no phase gates, no sign-off meetings. Requirements get challenged, not worked through. Delete first, then simplify, then accelerate - in that order.

Our milestones are binary. Testing happens in the field, not in simulation.


What you get
  • Full technical authority over a system in active deployment.
  • Direct contact with the customer, no layers in between.
  • A team that owns the mission itself.
  • Munich, 5 days on-site. We build together.

No job for you if
  • You need three meetings before a decision gets made.
  • You want a title. What we hand out is the final word and full consequence.
  • A good design matters more to you than a running, functional system.

Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

About the team

Design at Checkout brings together 30+ people across Product Design, UX Research, Content Design, Content Strategy and Technical Writing to create clear, intuitive experiences across our products.

The Content Design team is centralised and embedded in product domains, working across a wide range of projects.

The role

We’re looking for a Senior Content Designer to lead content design for a new and developing domain at Checkout. You’ll bring clarity to an opportunity as it takes shape, helping create experiences that are clear, useful and connected to the wider product ecosystem.

You’ll work closely with designers, product managers, researchers and engineers, and collaborate across Technical Writing, Creative Brand, Support, Legal and other teams. The role may also contribute to other product areas as priorities evolve.

What you’ll do

  • Bring content design into early product thinking, helping teams clarify problems, concepts and priorities.

  • Design and refine end-to-end journeys, using research, insight and testing to improve comprehension and usability.

  • Create practical guidance, terminology and reusable patterns that help teams deliver consistently as the product evolves.

  • Explain decisions clearly, build alignment across functions and contribute to ways of working across the Design organisation.

What success looks like

  • Content foundations are clear, adopted and used consistently across the domain.

  • Key journeys are easier to understand and use, with stronger comprehension and usability.

  • Content design has a visible influence on product decisions and ways of working across the domain, with useful contributions to the wider Design organisation.

What you'll bring

Research shows that some people are less likely to apply for a role unless they meet every requirement. If you’re excited about this role and think you might be a fit, but your experience doesn’t line up perfectly with everything below, we encourage you to still apply. We’re most interested in how you think, build, and navigate relationships and ambiguity.

  • Hands-on experience in content design or UX writing for digital products, including ownership of end-to-end product journeys.

  • Experience defining reusable UX content patterns and systems, not only writing individual screens.

  • Ability to simplify complex or regulated topics in plain language, without relying on jargon.

  • Experience bringing clarity to ambiguous or early-stage product problems and helping teams move from ideas to usable experiences.

  • Evidence of using research, insight, analytics or testing to inform, validate and improve product decisions.

  • Clear communication, sound product and content judgement, and hands-on collaboration with cross-functional teams using tools such as Figma and other evolving product workflows.

Nice to have

  • Experience in payments, fintech or complex B2B SaaS environments.

  • Experience building content foundations or ways of working for a new or developing product area.

  • Experience using AI-assisted tools in product design or content workflows, with the judgement to evaluate and improve their outputs.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

 

Your Team and Role

As a Senior Product Designer, Design Systems you'll be the first of its kind at DuckDuckGo. You'll take ownership of our design system at a pivotal moment, with a chance to define both a role and a roadmap from the ground up — helping build the process, not just step into one. You'll audit our existing system, lead projects that move it forward across platforms and products like Duck.ai and Search, as well as shape how we manage and scale it as we grow.

 

Applying your hands-on design skills, you will autonomously lead highly impactful projects that scale across millions of users, and collaborate with team members at all levels to pioneer new solutions as we build out the privacy layer for the internet. From ideation to execution, you'll assess vague problems, propose high-impact solutions, and execute them against a set of success criteria. You'll have a voice in all product-related design decisions, whether large or small, and an opportunity to work on a team dedicated to our ethical, privacy by design approach. Read more about Design at DuckDuckGo on our blog: https://spreadprivacy.com/ethical-by-design/

  • 7+ years of experience in product or design systems roles, including 2+ years in senior-level design positions at significant global consumer brands

Deine neue Rolle bei finway

Wir suchen ab sofort eine erfahrene und umsetzungsstarke Persönlichkeit als (Senior) Produkt Manager (m/w/d) für eine Elternzeitvertretung (erst einmal auf 2 Jahre befristet - potentielle unbefristete Anstellung nach dieser Zeit möglich).
In dieser Rolle übernimmst du das operative und strategische Produktmanagement. Du bildest die Brücke zwischen Softwareentwicklung, Design, Customer Success und Marketing und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Initiativen zielgerichtet und für unsere Kunden gewinnbringend umgesetzt werden.


Das sind Deine Aufgaben

Produktentwicklung & Agile Team-Führung

  • Agiles Arbeiten: Du steuerst das Entwicklerteam („Team Seal“) durch tägliche Dailies, zweiwöchentliche Sprint Plannings und Reviews inklusive Demos

  • Schnittstelle Dev: Du begleitest technische Umsetzungen eng (z. B. im Bereich KYB) und stimmst dich in Dev-Weeklies zu Architektur und technischer Ausrichtung ab

Cross-Functional Alignment & Kundenkontakt

  • Schnittstelle zu Go-To-Market & CS: Du arbeitest eng mit Customer Success (Enablement, Support-Sparring, Ticket-Eskalationen) und Product Marketing (Features, Positionierung) zusammen

  • Partner- & Kunden-Projekte: Du führst Workshops und Integrationen mit externen Partnern durch und begleitest Customer-Meetings, um Feedback einzuholen und komplexe Anwendungsfälle zu lösen

  • Sales Support & Webinare: Du unterstützt den Vertrieb bei Enterprise-Deals und konzipierst sowie hältst zweimonatliche Produkt-Webinare für unsere Kunden

Product Design, Specs & Testing

  • Konzeption & Architektur: Du entwirfst konkrete Produktlösungen (z. B. KI-gestützte Features) und schreibst präzise Anforderungsspezifikationen

  • Backlog- & Ticket-Management: Du priorisierst Sprints, organisierst den Backlog in enger Abstimmung mit CS und priorisierst Bug-Fixes

Job description

Who we are 
Millions of people live with urological and gynecological conditions they nevertalk about. We are here to end that silence. Kranus Health is a digital therapeutics platform running in several countries across urology and gynecology. Our newest therapy, Kranus Mictera, treats urinary incontinence in women, a condition that affects one in three women and that almost no onetakes seriously. Our therapies are built together with leading clinicians and scientists, prescribed by doctors, and reimbursed by health insurers, whichmeans everything you ship reaches patients with a real diagnosis instead of a wellness audience. We are ~50 people, everyone here owns outcomes ratherthan tickets, and AI is a settled part of how we work, so you won't be stuck in 2022 tooling here. One platform, many therapies, 3 countries. Small team. Big impact. If you live and breathe change, you will feel at home here.

The Role
As our Product Manager in charge of our consumer-facing Digital Therapeutics, you will lead the way to transform our platform of therapies from good to first-class with taste. This is not a feature-shipping role. We want someone who thinks in user journeys, obsesses over behavior change, and can tell the difference between a product that works and one that genuinely moves patients forward.

Your responsibilities

  • Therapy ownership: You own the full patient journey end-to-end – from the moment a doctor prescribes the therapy, through onboarding and the active therapy phase, to the point where patients feel a real difference and stay. AI is part of the work and part of the product – but it's a means to an end, not the goal itself. 
  • Behavior & retention: You apply proven knowledge of habit loops, nudges, feedback systems, and engagement mechanics to drive sustainable usage. 
  • Mobile ownership: You own our therapy apps across urology and gynecology end-to-end. 
  • App Store excellence: You treat ratings, store presence, and ASO as core product levers, and actively optimize the funnel from impression to activation.


YOUR TOOLKIT

  • Mobile expertise: Hands-on product management experience with consumer mobile apps. 
  • Platform fluency: You understand the technical realities of iOS and Android and know how to work with them – not around them. 
  • Data & AI fluency: You use AI to move fast, know when it's hallucinating, and back every decision with analytics and experiments, because you own the outcome.
  •  Languages: Fluent in German and English. 
  • High agency: You naturally push topics forward, bring people along, and don't wait to be asked. 
  • Taste: You know what a great, beautiful, yet functional product needs to look like in 2026. 
  • Optional – health or behavior background: Experience building patient-centric or behavior-change products, or genuine passion for it.


OUR SUPPORT AND YOUR BENEFITS

  • Trust - We believe in the talent we hire. You will receive a permanent contract. Home office is easily possible with us.
  • Body & Mind - You get an "Urban Sports Club" membership and your own leased bicycle at your free disposal.
  • Future - We support your company pension scheme and will be happy to explain the benefits to you.
  • Impact - work with meaning? Together with you we improve the health care of patients, every day.
  • Teamwork - You are part of a highly motivated team with flat hierarchies and a lot of fun at work.


CONTACT

Sounds like your next chapter? We'd love to receive your application! If you have any questions about the role or Kranus, feel free to reach out directly to our Senior People & Recruiting Manager, Annkathrin -----

jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Machine Learning
jobs.description:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why the Cohere TPM role?

As our Generative Machine Learning organization has continued growing, we are looking for more Technical Program Managers to join the team!

At Cohere, TPMs are pivotal to our success, being seen as operational experts specializing in cross-functional efforts. Great TPMs at Cohere are well-rounded, executing with precision at the tactical level, while partnering with senior leaders and shaping the big picture at a strategic level, and the opportunities are endless in growing the scale and impact of their work. Cohere’s TPMs would often be described as organized, execution-oriented, pragmatic leaders who are adaptable to the needs of the company and the programs they lead.

As a reward for the depth and breadth of expertize that you bring to the table, you will get to work alongside some of the most talented AI researchers and industry experts in the world on building cutting edge AI technology. No day will be the same as the one before, and the dynamic high growth environment will be absolutely perfect for anyone excited about solving novel problems, bringing structure to oftentimes chaotic and fast-paced environments, and ambitious about scaling their own impact and growth alongside the company!

Please note: While we are remote-first and accept candidates from all over the world, we are highly prioritizing hiring for people who are within 1-2 hours of British Standard Time (BST).

As a Machine Learning Technical Program Manager, you will:

  • Establish, improve, and scale foundational processes that allow the Generative Modeling teams to execute better, faster, and more predictably

  • Scale the operational capacity and effectiveness of the Modeling TPM team in collaboration with the Modeling TPM lead to ensure the function can remain lean and effective during a period of the program portfolio complexity and size continuing to rapidly increase

  • Flexibly adapt to the needs of the company, programs, and the team from tackling long-horizon programs that can span quarters or even years to jumping onto often highly ambiguous short-term challenges that can have company-wide impact

  • Partner directly with leaders within and outside of the Modeling organization on efforts to design, train and improve our core generative models

  • Lead cross-functional, oftentimes company-wide programs and strategic initiatives, collaborating and coordinating with cross-functional teams such as Product, Engineering, Legal, Platform, Infra, Policy, and Finance

  • Operate as an organizational expert in improving engineering execution rigor and operations on the ground, while contributing to the strategic layer in areas such as long-term strategic planning with senior modeling leadership

  • Map out dependencies and risks, and ensure that cross-functional execution across the program runs smoothly, communicating status with non-technical and technical stakeholders and senior management

  • Both own and enable a useful communication flow of priorities, ideas, and knowledge throughout and beyond the Modeling organization in line with your programs

  • Respond quickly to program-level changes, clarifying new scope, and managing resource needs in response to evolving priorities

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • 5-10 years as a Technical Program Manager AND 5+ years of experience working directly on AI/ML. Strong preference for candidates that have worked directly in building foundation models.

  • In-depth knowledge of machine learning, particularly when it comes to Natural Language Processing & Large Language Models (LLMs). Bonus points for experience with Multimodal AI.

  • Experience with working in a chaotic, fast paced, low structure environment. We need someone who is pragmatic, can roll up their sleeves when needed, and can function at the tactical and strategic level to do whatever it takes to make Cohere’s models succeed

  • Personal hands-on understanding of the unique challenges of managing projects and programs in the AI/ML development space as opposed to traditional software program management

  • Managed projects & programs requiring a strong general business acumen, such as coordinating with Finance on reporting needs or Policy on regulatory compliance matters — the broader your experience beyond ML technical program management, the better!

  • (optional, but preferred) Have technical experience in a hands-on capacity. We don’t necessarily need someone with hands on experience training models, but you need to feel comfortable sitting in the same rooms with some of the best researchers in the world, working on highly complex, cutting edge ML problems

If some of the above - other than the ML TPM experience - doesn’t line up perfectly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply! If you consider yourself a thoughtful worker, a lifelong learner, and a kind and playful team member, Cohere is the place for you.

We welcome applicants of all kinds and are committed to providing both an equal opportunity process and work environment. We value and celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive work environment for all.

Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks:

  • A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

  • Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

  • RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

  • 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

  • Annual enrichment benefits:

    Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

    Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

  • 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

  • Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How and Where We Work:

  • Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

  • For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

  • For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

  • Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form, and we will work together to meet your needs.

We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an ----- or ----- email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers page.
