Unser Anspruch: Beratung, Konzept und Umsetzung aus einer Hand, mit Senior-Teams, hohem Qualitätsstandard und klarer Verantwortung. 

Als Senior Account Manager (m/w/d) bist du die zentrale Informations- und Kommunikationsdrehscheibe zwischen Geschäftsführung, Experten-Teams und Kunden 

Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für unsere wertvollsten Kundenbeziehungen, professionalisierst unser Account Management weiter und entwickelst unseren bestehenden Kundenstamm proaktiv zu neuem Wachstum. Als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Geschäftsführung, Experten-Teams und Kunden bringst du dich bereits in der Vertriebsphase ein, erkennst Marktlücken und Potenziale frühzeitig und führst Kundenbeziehungen strategisch – von der Erstberatung über Workshops bis zum langfristigen Ausbau.


Deine Aufgaben:

  • Kundenführung: Du betreust eigenverantwortlich A-Potential-Accounts (sowie ausgewählte B-Accounts), steuerst deren Priorisierung, Ziel- und Maßnahmenplanung und erkennst ungenutzte Potenziale, um daraus neue Projekte anzustoßen und die Pipeline gezielt auszubauen.   • Beratung & Workshops: Du verantwortest Formate wie jährliche Kunden-Workshops und Reviews und berätst auf Basis der Zielsetzung, Budgets und internen Dynamiken deiner Kunden passgenau.

  • Risiko- & Eskalationsmanagement: Du erkennst kritische Kundensignale frühzeitig, klärst Eskalationen auf Entscheiderebene souverän und hältst den Projektteams den Rücken frei. 

  • Enger Sparringspartner der Geschäftsführung: Du berichtest regelmäßig zu Status, NRR, Kundenqualität und relevanten KPIs und treibst im engen Austausch die Weiterentwicklung unseres Account-Management-Systems voran.


Du bringst mit:

  • Fundierte Erfahrung im Senior / Lead Account Management: Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der strategischen Betreuung und Skalierung von B2B-Bestandskunden im Agentur- oder digitalen Beratungsumfeld.

  • Exzellentes Stakeholder-Management: Du baust ab Tag 1 Glaubwürdigkeit auf C-Level und Sponsorenebene auf und bewegst dich sicher auch in komplexen, konfliktbehafteten Kundensituationen.

  • Souveräne Moderation & Beratung: Erfahrung in Konzeption und Durchführung von Strategie-Workshops sowie in der zielgerichteten Moderation von Kundenterminen.

  • Ausgeprägtes Business- & Finanzverständnis: Kennzahlen wie NRR, Margen, Pipeline-Ökonomie und Kundenrentabilität sind für dich vertrautes Handwerkszeug. 

  • Analytisches Gespür & Proaktivität: Du erkennst aus scheinbar kleinen Signalen – etwa veränderten Budgetfreigaben, neuen Ansprechpartnern oder verzögerten Rückmeldungen – frühzeitig Chancen oder Risiken und leitest konkrete nächste Schritte daraus ab. 

  • Führung durch Überzeugung: Du überzeugst interdisziplinäre Teams inhaltlich für gemeinsame Ziele, auch ohne disziplinarische Weisungsbefugnis.


Deine Benefits:

  • Team & Atmosphäre: Familiäres, teamorientiertes Umfeld mit motivierten Kolleg:innen – hier entstehen Freundschaften.

  • Gute Kommunikation: Offene Feedbackkultur und kurze, unbürokratische Wege.

  • Flexibilität: Home Office und flexible Arbeitszeiten für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance. 

  • Transparente Zeitregelung: Jede Überstunde zählt – ab der ersten Minute.

  • Teamevents: Von Dönerstag bis Kinderfasching - wir lieben unsere regelmäßigen gemeinsamen Aktivitäten.

schoene neue kinder ist eine wachsende Digitalagentur mit dem Fokus auf Digital Customer Experiences. Unsere DNA besteht zu 100 % aus Design und zu 100 % aus Technologie.

jobs.title: Field & Campaign Manager DACH (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Stadtwerke, Energieversorger und Netzbetreiber stehen mitten in der digitalen Transformation, und epilot ist mit der Energy-XRM-Plattform ihr Partner auf diesem Weg. Damit wir in DACH weiter wachsen, wollen wir genau die Unternehmen erreichen, die uns noch nicht kennen. Branchen-Messen, Fachkonferenzen und persönliche Begegnungen sind dafür unser wichtigster Hebel, denn in der Energiewirtschaft entstehen Geschäftsbeziehungen im direkten Gespräch. Diese Momente verbinden wir mit ABM, Kampagnen und enger Zusammenarbeit mit Sales, damit aus einem guten Gespräch echte Pipeline wird.

epilot digitalisiert die Energiewirtschaft mit einer einzigartigen Cloud-Software. Wir sind ein wachsendes Scale-up im Herzen von Köln. Unsere Mission: epilot revolutioniert die Zusammenarbeit aller Marktpartner, die gemeinsam Produkte und Dienstleistungen in der Energiewelt erbringen. Innerhalb unserer Cloud-Welt bieten wir ein großes Partner-Netzwerk, das durch unsere Community stetig wächst.


Das erwartet dich

  • Du planst und führst Field- und ABM-Programme für priorisierte Zielsegmente in DACH, mit klaren Zielen für Leads, Lead-Qualität und Pipeline.

  • Für unsere strategischen Zielaccounts verantwortest du ABM strategisch und operativ, von der Account-Auswahl bis zur koordinierten Multi-Channel-Ansprache.

  • Kampagnen über E-Mail, LinkedIn, Sales-Mailings, Paid und Retargeting steuerst du so, dass Leads entstehen und sich durch den Funnel bewegen. Die Inhalte setzt du gemeinsam mit Product Marketing und Freelancer:innen um.

  • Du wählst externe Messen, Konferenzen und Fachevents danach aus, ob sie neue Zielaccounts erreichen. Vorab-Ansprache, Lead-Erfassung und Nachbereitung liegen bei dir.

  • Mit Side Events baust du schon vor dem eigentlichen Event persönliche Bindung zu Neu- und Bestandskund:innen auf.

  • Du trackst MQLs, SQLs und Pipeline-Beitrag in HubSpot und lieferst belastbare Reportings.

  • Gemeinsam mit unserem Partner Manager treibst du gemeinsame Kampagnen, Messestände und Networking-Events voran.

Wirkung & Zusammenarbeit

  • Du denkst in Zahlen (Meetings, Demos, Opportunities) und machst sichtbar, wie viel Pipeline unsere Events wirklich beeinflussen.

  • Events sind dein Ankerpunkt. Über ABM, Webinare und Sales-Mailings verstärkst du sie gezielt, statt sie isoliert zu betrachten.

  • In enger Abstimmung mit Sales sorgst du dafür, dass deine Programme direkt auf die Geschäftsziele einzahlen. Dazu gehören Lead-Übergabe, Nurturing und die Conversion zur Opportunity.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Event Managerin (interne, kundenzentrierte Events), unserem Growth & Campaign Manager, unserer Product Marketing Managerin und weiteren Stakeholdern zusammen.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Marketing mit Fokus auf Demand Generation, ABM oder Field Marketing. Du weißt, wie aus einem Touchpoint ein Funnel wird.

  • Proaktivität: Statt auf ein Briefing zu warten, erkennst du früh, wo ein Channel Potenzial hat, welche Ziele es braucht und wann Sales ins Spiel kommt.

  • Du trittst gegenüber Stakeholdern bis zum C-Level souverän auf und überzeugst mit Kommunikationsstärke und Begeisterung.

  • Große und kleine (Networking-)Events sind genau dein Ding. Du gehst gern auf Menschen zu und bist mittendrin statt nur dabei.

  • Reisebereitschaft von ca. 20–30 %. Unsere Branche ist klein und manchmal speziell, deshalb ist ein Gespür für die Zielgruppe wichtig. Gerade am Anfang solltest du oft vor Ort dabei sein.

  • Fließendes Deutsch und Englisch. Englisch ist unsere Unternehmenssprache in einem diversen, internationalen Team.

  • Führerschein Klasse B, damit du vor Ort flexibel unterwegs bist.

  • Du lebst in Köln oder Umgebung und kommst gern regelmäßig ins Office, vor allem zum Marketing Monday. Homeoffice ist selbstverständlich, persönlicher Austausch ist uns trotzdem wichtig, und viele Events finden ohnehin in Köln statt.

  • Du verstehst, worauf es für epilot ankommt, und richtest deine täglichen Entscheidungen danach aus.

  • Als Teamplayer:in motivierst und begeisterst du deine Kolleg:innen und willst etwas bewegen.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Die Möglichkeit, die erfolgreichste SaaS-Plattform auf dem Energiemarkt mit aufzubauen.

  • Start-up-Mentalität: dynamische Atmosphäre und großartiger Teamspirit.

  • Ein stark wachsendes Unternehmen mit offener Kommunikationskultur, motivierten Kolleg:innen, und internationaler Unternehmenskultur

  • Exponentielle Lernkurve – epilot wächst rasant, selbiges erwarten wir von dir

  • Einen zentralen und modernen Standort im Herzen von Köln mit coolen Cafés direkt um die Ecke

  • Transparenz – Wir pflegen eine sehr flache und offene Unternehmenskultur, alles ist einsehbar und steht zur Diskussion.

  • Regelmäßige Teamevents wie bspw. zu Karneval, das Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier, Company breakfast und noch viel mehr Gelegenheiten deine epilot:innen auch außerhalb der Arbeitszeiten kennenzulernen

  • Die Möglichkeit für mobiles, flexibles Arbeiten, Sportangebote u.v.m.


Immer noch nicht überzeugt? Hier unser Versprechen an alle zukünftigen epilot:innen 💙 promise.epilot.cloud/

Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Herkunft, unabhängig von Geschlecht, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Alter, Behinderung oder sexueller Orientierung!

P.S.: Falls du dir nicht sicher bist, ob diese Stelle noch offen sein sollte, dann schau einfach unter https://epilot.cloud/karriere/ (dort findest du natürlich auch alle weiteren offenen Positionen). Wenn sie dort noch online ist, dann suchen wir auch noch bzw. wieder ;). Also: worauf wartest du noch?

Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


🌏 Location: You can choose to work in Qonto as long as you're living in (or willing to relocate to) either Germany, France, Italy, Serbia, or Spain.
 
Mission: Join us as a Web Engineer to craft the web apps that 600,000+ European SMEs rely on every day, from the customer-facing features that make finance simpler to the design system powering every pixel of our product.

➡️ As a Web Engineer at Qonto, you will

  • Craft new features for our customers within a squad Team, owning quality from design to production.
  • Grow in technical leadership: lead design discussions, contribute to guild-wide improvement, and raise the bar for developer experience across your peers
  • Be a key player in teamwork with Product, Design, and other Tech stacks
  • Work AI-first: use AI as a default part of how you explore the codebase, draft technical designs, prototype solutions, and accelerate delivery, while keeping strong human judgment and quality standards

➡️  What you can expect: our methodology, the Qonto Way

  • At Qonto, we value diversity and are proud to have 33% non-male in our Frontend guild.
  • You will contribute to and use our own design system and UI library, which we built from scratch.
  • You will be part of a team that is driven by quality. Our org assigns one team lead per project across stacks, giving your team a clear mission and full autonomy on how it operates
  • You will have access to best-in-class AI tools (e.g., Claude / Claude Code and internal workflows) and the autonomy to experiment, share learnings, and help scale what works across the guild
  • You will bring your energy and skills to improve the team’s tools and processes at many levels, contributing to a better developer experience for all your peers.
You can watch this interview of Imen, who joined the team as a Lead in January 2023.
 

➡️  Your future team

As a Web Engineer, you'll join one of Qonto's squad teams, each with a clear project mission, one team lead, and full product ownership.
You'll be part of a 100+ strong Frontend community within a 500+ Product Engineering department, working in teams of 5 to 10 people alongside Product, Design, and peers from Backend and Mobile.
 
We hold ourselves to high standards, and we've shipped several open-source JS libraries along the way. 

➡️ About You

To succeed as a Web Engineer at Qonto, you will need to demonstrate:
  1. Proficiency in frontend engineering: you have at least three years of professional experience using React.js, as well as HTML and CSS. We don’t use CSS libraries such as Tailwind, so you will need to know how to write pure CSS.

  3. Communication skills: you explain your thoughts in a clear, organized, concise and accurate manner.
  4. AI fluency & good judgment: you can leverage AI to move faster (research, writing, coding, testing) while staying critical, validating outputs, and protecting the product’s reliability and user trust

jobs.title: Partner Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 million de TPE/PME et plus de 8000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

L’un des atouts majeurs de Pennylane aujourd’hui est son réseau de partenaires revendeurs.

Le Partner marketing specialist a un rôle essentiel dans le développement de notre écosystème partenaires en pilotant notre stratégie marketing via nos partenaires revendeurs (intégrateurs). Il a pour objectif de générer des leads qualifiés et de renforcer notre position de leader dans la gestion financière.
En collaboration étroite avec notre équipe partenariat et les partner account managers, ce rôle implique la conception et le déploiement de campagnes de co-marketing innovantes. L'objectif est de créer des synergies durables qui alimentent notre croissance tout en maximisant la visibilité de notre proposition de valeur unique.
Le succès de cette mission repose sur une approche méthodique combinant la génération d'opportunités commerciales, le développement de relations partenaires privilégiées et l'exécution de campagnes marketing à fort impact mesurable.

Missions

  • Gérer les relations avec les équipes marketing des partenaires, en assurant une communication efficace et en identifiant de nouvelles opportunités de collaboration.

  • Élaborer et gérer des campagnes de co-marketing, y compris des webinaires, des événements, des contenus partagés, etc.

  • Suivre et analyser les performances des campagnes pour optimiser les stratégies et assurer un retour sur investissement positif.

  • Collaborer avec les équipes internes (partenariats, marketing, sales, product marketing) pour aligner les initiatives marketing avec les objectifs commerciaux de Pennylane.

  • Former et accompagner les partenaires sur les supports marketing disponibles

Profil recherché

  • Une première expérience en marketing BtoB SaaS avec animation de partenaires

  • Communication en interne et en externe

  • Maitrise des outils marketing

  • Bonne gestion de projet

  • Maitrise de l’anglais professionnel

  • Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles

  • Capacité à travailler en équipe

  • Autonomie

  • Proactivité

  • Sens de l’organisation

Formation :

  • Formation supérieure en marketing et/ou commerce, niveau Bac +5

  • Expérience demandée : 3 ans

  • Connaissance du monde des partenariats revendeurs et logiciels

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

Process de recrutement

  • Échange téléphonique avec Barbara, notre TA - 30 min - Remote

  • Entretien avec Anne-Sophie, Team Lead Partner Marketing - Remote

  • Use case et debriefing avec Maxime, CMO, & Anne-Sophie, Team Lead Partner Marketing - Remote

  • Team fit avec l’équipe - Présentiel ou Remote

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

  • Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

  • Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

  • Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

  • Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec le domaine @pennylane.com.

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. Du möchtest an einer Legal-Tech-Anwendung arbeiten, die für E-Commerce-Unternehmen wie eine digitale Rechtsabteilung funktioniert? Du denkst Systeme vom Datenmodell bis zur Oberfläche, konzipierst gern technische Lösungen und übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, dass sie am Ende auch so umgesetzt werden? Dann bist du als Senior Fullstack-Entwickler (m/w/d) / Senior Webentwickler PHP/Laravel (m/w/d) beim Händlerbund genau richtig!

Bei uns entwickelst du an einer Plattform, die rechtliche Prozesse digital abbildet und automatisiert. Von der Erstellung rechtlicher Inhalte über Vertrags- und Prüfprozesse bis hin zu Datenschutz- und Sicherheitsfragen. Dazu gehören Schnittstellen und Plugins, über die unsere Inhalte in die Shopsysteme unserer Mitglieder gelangen, sowie Integrationen mit Partnersystemen. Ziel ist es, komplexe rechtliche Anforderungen in verlässliche, verständliche und effiziente digitale Workflows zu überführen.

In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die technische Leitung von Projekten, die wir in kleinen Projektteams umsetzen: Du konzipierst Lösungen, verantwortest die Umsetzung, leitest andere Entwickler im Projekt an und hältst alle Beteiligten über den Stand auf dem Laufenden. Kleinere Projekte setzt du eigenständig komplett um, bei größeren arbeitest du im Team mit Laravel und Livewire im Stack.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Technische Konzeption: Analyse von Anforderungen, Entwurf der Lösungsarchitektur, Festlegung von Datenmodellen und Schnittstellen sowie Einschätzung von Aufwänden für Features und Projekte.

  • Reporting: Regelmäßige, verständliche Berichte zu Stand, Risiken und nächsten Schritten an Team Lead, Product Owner und Stakeholder.

  • Fullstack-Entwicklung: Umsetzung mit Laravel, Livewire, Alpine.js, Flux UI und Tailwind CSS. Kleinere Projekte eigenständig von Anfang bis Ende, größere im Projektteam.

  • Partneranbindungen & Integrationen: Lösungsevaluierung, Umsetzung und Dokumentation von Schnittstellen zu Partner- und Drittsystemen.

  • Architektur & Technologie-Evaluation: Mitgestaltung von Architektur, Entwicklungsstandards und Tooling; Evaluation neuer Technologien, Frameworks und KI-Einsatzmöglichkeiten im Hinblick auf ihren konkreten Nutzen für Produkt und Team.


Dein Profil

Technisch

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit PHP & Laravel: Entwicklung von Webanwendungen über den gesamten Stack, im Frontend idealerweise mit Livewire, Alpine.js, Flux UI und Tailwind CSS.

  • Konzeption & technische Leitung: Erfahrung darin, technische Konzepte zu erarbeiten und deren Umsetzung zu verantworten, allein oder als technische Leitung eines Projektteams.

  • Code Reviews über den gesamten Stack: Praxis im Review von Backend- und Frontend-Code und die Fähigkeit, Feedback so zu geben, dass andere daran wachsen.

  • Testerfahrung: Sicherer Umgang mit PHPUnit oder Pest und Erfahrung mit Teststrategien in größeren Codebasen. Tests sind für dich Teil der Umsetzung, nicht Nacharbeit.

  • Datenbanken & APIs: Sicherer Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken, Datenmodellierung und API-Design.

  • Agile Teamarbeit: Erfahrung in agilen Teams, idealerweise mit Scrum, inklusive enger Zusammenarbeit und kontinuierlichem Austausch.


Nice to Have, aber kein Muss

  • DevOps-Erfahrung: Cloud-Systeme, PaaS-Plattformen, Container, CI/CD oder Linux-Serveradministration (z.B. DigitalOcean und Laravel Cloud)

  • Erfahrung mit Shopsystemen und der Entwicklung von Plugins oder Apps dafür (z.B. Shopify oder JTL)

  • Gespür für UX und Erfahrung in der Gestaltung benutzerfreundlicher Oberflächen

  • Erfahrung mit Event-basierten Architekturen, Queues oder asynchronen Verarbeitungsprozessen

  • Erfahrung mit der Integration von LLM-APIs in Produktfeatures (Prompting, Evaluierung, Guardrails)


Persönlich

  • Ownership: Du fühlst dich für das Ergebnis eines Projekts verantwortlich. Von der ersten Skizze bis zum Go-live und darüber hinaus und nicht nur für deine eigenen Tickets.

  • Systemisches Denken: Du siehst die Auswirkungen von Änderungen über Komponenten- und Teamgrenzen hinweg.

  • Strukturierte Kommunikation: Du bereitest den Stand eines Projekts für technische und nicht-technische Beteiligte verständlich auf, auch dann, wenn etwas nicht nach Plan läuft.

  • Pragmatismus: Du findest die Balance zwischen sauberer Lösung und pragmatischem Fortschritt.

  • Wissenstransfer: Du hast Freude daran, Wissen weiterzugeben und andere im Team besser zu machen, bspw. in Reviews, Pairings und Dokumentation.

  • KI als Werkzeug: Du nutzt KI-Tools im Entwicklungsalltag selbstverständlich und beurteilst nüchtern, wo sie im Produkt echten Nutzen bringen und wo nicht.


Warum wir?

Code. Chill. Repeat.

  • 4 Tage Code – 3 Tage du selbst: Bei uns ist die 4-Tage-Woche Standard. Kein Gimmick, sondern Realität. Du arbeitest remote oder im Leipziger Büro – so, wie du am besten performst. Flexzeiten, kein Micromanagement, volle Eigenverantwortung. Und ja: unbefristet von Anfang an.

  • Dein Stack, dein Style: Wir stehen auf smarte Lösungen, sauberen Code und Menschen, die mitdenken. Du willst mitentscheiden, ausprobieren und nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten? Here you go. Plus: Mentoring, Weiterbildung nach Bedarf und Raum für echte Weiterentwicklung.

  • Professionalität: echte Qualität statt Show-off. Wir leben agile Entwicklung mit klaren Iterationen und direktem Feedback. Du arbeitest mit modernen, professionellen Tools, mit klaren Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten – du weißt genau, was dein Job ist und hast die Freiheit, ihn so zu machen, wie es richtig ist. Sauberer Code, smarte Entscheidungen und ein Team, das zusammenarbeitet. Professionalität heißt hier: Du kannst dich auf das konzentrieren, was du am besten kannst – entwickeln.

  • Snacks, Swag & Softdrinks: Obst, Müsli, Kaffee, Wasser – alles for free. Kein Dresscode. Komm, wie du bist. Hauptsache du fühlst dich wohl.

  • Perks, die was bringen: Kita-Zuschuss, Unterstützung bei der Altersvorsorge, Leipziger Jobticket oder sportliche Angebote für deinen Ausgleich – vom Homegym bis zum Fitnessstudio für Kopf und Körper.


Dein Weg zu uns

Keine Lust auf lange Anschreiben? Kein Problem! Erzähl uns einfach kurz, warum du Teil vom Händlerbund werden möchtest und warum wir gut zu dir passen. Nutze dazu die Möglichkeit dich online über unser Bewerbungsformular zu bewerben.

TEAM DEVELOPMENT & MENTORING: You will share your expertise, support colleagues in challenging sales situations, and provide structured feedback. Even before taking on formal leadership, you will strengthen shared standards, improve ways of working, and support the team in its day-to-day business.

LEADERSHIP PERSPECTIVE: You will have the opportunity to develop towards the Sales Lead role for Remazing Core. Your profile

GLOBAL SALES MINDSET: You operate confidently in an international environment, adapt to different markets and cultures, and manage complex processes across countries and teams.

LEADERSHIP POTENTIAL: You enjoy supporting others, sharing knowledge, and providing clear direction. Initial experience in leadership, mentoring, or coaching is highly welcome; most importantly, you are motivated to take ownership and develop towards a formal people leadership role.

STRUCTURED & DATA-DRIVEN APPROACH: You work independently, in a structured way, and with a strong focus on results. CRM discipline, reliable forecasting, and data-led prioritisation are integral to your approach to professional sales management.

About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.


Your Mission

Help build the financial crime operations that make investing safer and scalable.

As our Senior Financial Crime Operations Specialist (AFC), you will be the sole dedicated AFC Operations specialist in the first line of defence. This is a high-ownership role: you will shape the AFC operating model from the ground up, owning hands-on operations while building the processes, controls, workflows and documentation needed to support a growing regulated business.

You will work closely with the MLRO and Second Line of Defence on oversight, escalation and regulatory matters, and with Customer Lifecycle, Product, Engineering and Operations to make AFC controls effective, scalable and audit-ready.

During your first 6–12 months, you will establish and improve processes covering transaction monitoring, customer screening, Source of Wealth reviews, investigations and regulatory information requests, while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency through better workflows, tooling and automation.

This role is for someone who enjoys autonomy, brings structure to evolving environments and can influence stakeholders across teams. You will not be joining a AFC operations team; you will be the main hands-on AFC Operations owner and will have the opportunity to shape how the function develops.


In this role you will:

  • Own hands-on AFC operations across transaction monitoring, customer screening, Source of Wealth reviews, investigations and regulatory information requests. You will make risk-based decisions and collaborate with the MLRO and Second Line of Defence on escalations and suspicious activity reporting.

  • Build and maintain the AFC operating model by translating regulatory requirements and risk assessments into clear controls, workflows, work instructions, ownership and audit-ready documentation across the customer lifecycle.

  • Improve and optimise AFC processes and workflows, identifying opportunities to reduce manual effort, strengthen control effectiveness and increase operational efficiency through automation and better tooling.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to define operational requirements and implement practical workflow, tooling and automation improvements. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you should be comfortable working with technical teams to turn AFC needs into effective solutions.

  • Manage stakeholders across Customer Lifecycle, Product, Engineering, Operations, Banking and Investing, as well as external partners, acting as the main AFC subject-matter expert and building alignment across teams with different priorities.

You’ll be successful in this role if you:

  • Bring substantial hands-on experience in financial crime or AFC operations within a regulated financial-services, fintech, banking, payments or investment environment.

  • Have professional fluency in written and spoken German, enabling you to work independently with German-speaking stakeholders, and communicate confidently in English. German and English communication skills are required for this role.

  • Have a proven track record of building, documenting, standardising and optimising AFC or financial-crime processes, controls and workflows, including identifying automation opportunities and partnering with Product, Engineering or other technical teams to implement effective improvements.

  • Have practical experience handling suspicious activity cases, preparing or contributing to suspicious activity or transaction reports, and using goAML or a comparable reporting system.

  • Can translate regulatory requirements, risk assessments and control expectations into clear, consistently applied, documented and audit-ready operational procedures, with a solid understanding of relevant German and European financial-crime requirements.

  • Have strong stakeholder-management skills and the confidence to act as the main AFC subject-matter expert across regulatory, operational, business and technical teams.

  • Are comfortable working independently, taking ownership and bringing structure to ambiguity while building AFC Operations without an established team around you.


How we take care of you

  • 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets.

  • 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate.

Senior Go Backend Developer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Serving 2,000+ Distinct Ad Experiences With Sub-Second Time to Interactive

The rewarded ad experience is where the value exchange becomes real, the second a user decides whether to engage or scroll past. The Catalog team owns that moment, designing how users discover and interact with the most relevant ads. With over 200 million monthly visits, there's no room for slow rendering or poor personalization. Performance and relevance have to be perfect on every request.

The system runs on AWS Spot Instances spare compute capacity that can disappear at any moment, yet our system is built to stay online without any interruption for the user. Backed by Kubernetes with event-driven autoscaling, everything is tuned for millisecond-level data retrieval so the experience never feels slow, even at 200 million monthly visits. The frontend is built on React and Vite, leveraging Code Splitting and Tree Shaking to keep core bundles lean and Time to Interactive under a second. On top of that, a config-driven engine lets the team customize the entire ad experience or run A/B experiments per more than 2000 games on the fly, ensuring the right ad reaches the right user while continuously moving conversion rates in the right direction.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For

  • Production Golang Systems Expertise: You bring 5+ years of backend development experience, including at least 3 years writing Go in production distributed environments. You will build and maintain our +99% Go microservice architecture—interfacing with our TypeScript/React frontend—to reliably handle 2+ million daily publisher interactions and scale beyond hundreds of millions of monthly active users.

  • High-Throughput Event Streaming: You have hands-on experience designing asynchronous microservice communication using event buses like Kafka, SQS/SNS, and Kinesis. You will build pipelines to collect billions of daily API events and aggregate them into our data lake for sub-second querying.

  • High-Scale Data & API Optimization: You understand database internals and low-level web standards (HTTP protocol, Encoding, Regular Expressions). You will optimize queries across hundreds of terabytes of data across DynamoDB, MySQL, Druid, and Athena to reduce API response times and expose transparent, well-documented open APIs to enterprise partners.

  • Data Science & Algorithmic Integration: You quickly grasp complex technical topics and applied mathematics. You will partner directly with our Data Science team to translate and integrate machine learning algorithms into adjoe’s core application, optimizing real-time ad targeting.

  • Collaborative Technical Communication: You communicate fluently and precisely in spoken and written English. You will actively participate in peer code reviews and technical knowledge sharing across an international backend engineering team.

  • Plus: Infrastructure & Cloud Tooling: Hands-on experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code), Docker containerization, or serverless infrastructure.

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

 

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

  • Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

  • Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

  • Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

  • Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.

  • Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we're scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity.

Why This Role

We're seeking a bilingual Management Accountant to serve as the cornerstone of our German accounting operations. This role combines hands-on accounting execution with strategic financial operations, ensuring seamless coordination between our German and US entities while maintaining compliance with both German and US GAAP standards.

You'll work at the intersection of day-to-day financial operations and cross-border business requirements, partnering closely with our Head of Finance, People Operations, external payroll providers, and local German accounting advisors to maintain accurate, timely financial reporting across our dual-entity structure.

What You’ll Work On

Core Accounting Operations

  • Manage full-cycle billing, collections, and accounts payable for German entity

  • Execute treasury and cash management functions, including inter-company settlements

  • Process and reconcile inter-company transactions between German and US entities

  • Partner with People Operations and external payroll agencies across Europe to ensure accurate and timely payroll accounting entries

  • Review payroll outputs from external providers and post journal entries to the general ledger

  • Reconcile payroll-related balance sheet accounts (accruals, statutory deductions, benefits) each month

  • Maintain accurate books and records in accordance with German GAAP (HGB)

  • Maintain dual bookkeeping across DATEV (German statutory books) and Rillet (global ERP), ensuring both systems remain accurate, aligned, and reconciled on an ongoing basis

Tax & Compliance

  • Coordinate with external German accountants (Steuerberater) to ensure accurate VAT returns and filings

  • Support annual tax compliance including Körperschaftsteuer and Gewerbesteuer

  • Maintain documentation for tax audits and statutory requirements

  • Monitor regulatory changes affecting German accounting and tax obligations

US GAAP Reporting Support

  • Assist in reconciling German GAAP accounts to US GAAP basis

  • Provide monthly financial data and schedules for consolidated US GAAP reporting

  • Support quarter-end and year-end close processes for global consolidation

  • Help maintain documentation for US GAAP accounting policies and procedures

Process & Systems

  • Implement and improve accounting processes and internal controls

  • Work with ERP and financial systems to enhance efficiency and accuracy

  • Support integration of German operations into global financial infrastructure

  • Maintain organized documentation for internal and external stakeholders

What We’re Looking For:

  • Education: Completed Ausbildung as Steuerfachangestellter/ Steuerfachwirt or similar accounting qualification; Bachelor's degree in Finance/Accounting preferred

  • Experience: 3 plus years experience in accounting role(s), preferably in fast-growing companies or startups

  • Language: Full fluency in both German and English is a core requirement

  • Technical: Strong proficiency with accounting software and Excel; experience with ERP systems

  • Location: Based in or willing to relocate to Freiburg, Germany

While not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience with DATEV and/or modern cloud ERP systems (e.g., Rillet, NetSuite)

  • Familiarity with both German GAAP (HGB) and US GAAP principles

  • Experience working in dual-entity or international company structures

  • Prior work with German Steuerberater and understanding of VAT compliance

  • Experience coordinating with People Operations and third-party payroll providers (rather than running payroll directly)

  • Experience in technology or SaaS companies

  • Knowledge of intercompany accounting and transfer pricing basics

How We Work Together

We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. Depending on your role, you’ll either join us in Freiburg or SF at least 2 days a week (or one full week every other week), or work remotely with a monthly in-person week to stay connected. We’ll cover reasonable travel costs to make this possible. We think in-person time matters, and we’ve structured things to make it accessible to all. We’ll discuss what this will look like for the role during our interview process.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

  • Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

  • Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

  • Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

  • Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you.

Base Annual Salary: EU €70,000- €100,000 + Equity

As an Account Manager at Aircall, you are the owner of customer success and revenue growth across your portfolio. This is a highly strategic and commercial role — blending consultative relationship management with the rigor and energy of a quota-carrying seller. You’ll partner cross-functionally with Customer Engineering, Product, and Support to accelerate adoption, drive usage of add-on SKUs, and build deep, long-term relationships with customers at all levels of their organizations.
 
Aircall is undergoing an exciting transformation — building on our market-leading communications platform and introducing AI functionality that helps customers operate more intelligently, efficiently, and competitively. Join us and be part of shaping that journey.
 
This is a hybrid role, in office 3 days a week in Paris.

jobs.description:
Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.


The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But International Fintechs and non-US banks are left with two unsatisfying options to access it: Either they build on legacy clearing banks that are slow and unreliable, or they interface with middleware providers that don’t move and hold the dollars directly, but themselves rely on underlying legacy banks. Augustus collapses this stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of operators, unicorn early employees, ex-founders and people who walked away from degrees because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and n8n.


We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

You will own security engineering end-to-end across application, infrastructure, and incident response: partnering with product and platform teams during design, writing and shipping security automation in production, and leading high-quality response when something breaks. Day to day, you will help define security in a greenfield modern bank, moving beyond threat modeling, harden cloud and CI/CD paths, build detection and response workflows, and drive remediation to closure with clear risk tradeoffs. This role reports to the CISO. What matters most is measurable risk reduction that keeps product velocity high.

 

Your First Six Months

Understand the foundations and increase your ownership rapidly.

  • Months 1-2: Enforce an SSDLC that codifies existing security goals across EU-live payment/ledger services and US launch-critical services into required design, build, and release checkpoints (ownership, control evidence, and exception handling), with 100% of net-new Tier-1 changes following the workflow.

  • Months 3-4: Stand up an AI-native product-security review pipeline that auto-triages code/dependency/IaC findings by service criticality, proposes fixes in pull requests, and routes owner-tagged remediation tasks and reduces non-actionable security alerts.

  • Months 5-6: Expand baseline coverage to >=85% of Tier-1 services for workload identity hardening, secret management standards, runtime audit logging, and high-severity dependency monitoring; start monthly control-evidence reporting to Security & Compliance.

Who Will Thrive At Augustus

We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. The people who succeed here share the following traits:

  • Relentless: You can't leave something broken. You don't stop because it got hard or because no one is watching.

  • Set The Bar: You're harder on yourself than anyone else would be. You don't need external accountability to care about quality.

  • Shape The Game: You don't wait for a playbook and you don't need one. You walk into genuinely new territory and figure it out. You move before anyone asked you to.

  • Systems First: You don't solve problems by adding people or effort. You build systems that make the problem smaller. Your first instinct is to automate, not to handle it manually.

 

This role is for you if:

  • You can point to security automation you personally built that replaced recurring manual review work.

  • You have strong product security fundamentals and can improve secure-by-default patterns in fast-moving engineering teams.

  • You have led end-to-end rollout of security controls in production, from design and implementation through adoption and evidence.

  • You regularly influence architecture decisions before launch through fast, lightweight risk reviews and pragmatic controls.

  • You are comfortable writing production-grade code or infrastructure changes, not only policy or tickets.

  • You use AI tooling to accelerate security reviews and remediation planning without lowering quality or signal.

  • You push ambiguous work forward without waiting for a complete playbook, and you bring stakeholders with you.

This is not for you if:

  • You prefer advisory-only security roles and do not want direct implementation ownership.

  • You need tightly scoped tickets to make progress and are uncomfortable defining the plan yourself.

  • You avoid ownership of production systems and control implementation work.

  • You optimize for stability over change and are not excited by early-stage ambiguity.

 

Hard Requirements

  • Extensive experience in hands-on security engineering, product security, cloud security, or detection/response engineering in production environments

  • Demonstrated expertise securing cloud-based systems (IAM, networking, logging, key management, workload isolation) and CI/CD pipelines

  • Proven experience building at least one security automation or detection capability that is actively used in production

  • Experience in fintech, payments, banking, or another regulated environment with audit and control evidence requirements

  • Experience with modern security tooling, especially SIEM/SOAR and cloud security platforms

  • Located in (or willing to relocate to) Berlin and able to work in-office 3 days/week

 

Pay transparency

Compensation packages at Augustus include base salary, equity, and benefits. New hire offers are made based on a candidate's experience, expertise and geographic location. The annual base salary range for this role is €100,000-€150,000 + equity.

What We Offer

  • Career Growth: You will be given more responsibility and pushed to grow faster than ever before.

  • Network: Your peers are brilliant, highly motivated people. These people will be foundational in your future opportunities.

  • Real Participation: Employees are shareholders. You will think and act like an owner.

  • Perks & Benefits: Relocation support, visa support, the latest Apple gear (MacBook + AirPods), lunch benefit, gym benefit, a beautiful office in the heart of the city, 4x on-/offsites per year, and an annual development budget.

Additional to the global benefits above, we offer localized benefits such as comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance and a 401(k) retirement plan for our US team.

Augustus is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Augustus will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive - EMEA
jobs.description:
About Abacum

Abacum is the leading Business Planning solution for finance teams to drive performance. By automating reporting, enabling collaboration, and simplifying planning and forecasting, we help finance teams shift from number crunching to driving strategic decisions.

Founded in 2020 by two former CFOs, we’ve grown into a global team of 100+ people across 30+ nationalities. Headquartered in New York, we have offices in Toronto and Barcelona. We’re trusted by industry leaders such as Dish Networks, Strava, BetterUp, Kajabi, JG Wentworth, Abridge, Cortex, and hundreds more.

We have raised over $100m, closing in June 2025 our $60M Series B, led by Scale Venture Partners, with the strong participation of Cathay Innovation, Y Combinator, Atomico, Creandum, and angel operators from Adyen, Zapier, and Twitch.

Our mission is ambitious and we can’t do it alone - join Abacum as we build the future of Business Planning!

We are looking for...

An enterprise seller who already knows the Office of the CFO. You've carried a number selling planning, EPM, FP&A or finance software. You know how a CFO buys, how a steering committee stalls, and how to get a multi-stakeholder deal signed.

At Abacum you'll own a named territory of enterprise and upper mid-market accounts across EMEA. Many of them run legacy planning tools or spreadsheets that can't keep up with the business. Your job is to show them a better foundation, and win.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will...

- Own the full sales cycle for a named book of enterprise accounts, from first meeting to signed contract

- Build and run your own pipeline through targeted outbound, events, and partner co-selling with ERP vendors and implementation partners

- Sell to CFOs, VPs of Finance and Heads of FP&A, and bring IT, procurement, security and legal along the way

- Run complex evaluations: discovery, business cases, proofs of concept, and competitive displacements

- Forecast with discipline and keep a clean pipeline in CRM

- Work with Solutions Engineering, Product and Leadership to shape deals, and feed what you hear in the market back into the roadmap

What we need...

- 6+ years of quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales, with at least 3 years closing enterprise deals

- Experience selling EPM, FP&A, planning, or other Office-of-the-CFO software (finance, ERP, spend, or data platforms)

- A track record of closing six-figure ARR deals with 3–6 month cycles and hitting or beating quota

- Comfort leading multi-stakeholder deals with finance, IT, procurement and security at the table

- Experience displacing an incumbent, whether a legacy system or a spreadsheet-based process

- A consultative, value-based approach: you build a business case in a CFO's language

- The drive to build your own pipeline, not wait for inbound

- Clear, sharp written and verbal communication, including running demos with senior buyers

- Based in EMEA, with the ability to travel to customers and events

Bonus points if you have...

- Sold with or through ERP ecosystems (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics) or implementation partners

- Worked in finance, or you're comfortable talking models, drivers and variances with an FP&A team

- Used a structured sales method (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or similar)

- Been an early seller at a scaling company and helped build the enterprise playbook

Why sell Abacum

You know the category. Here's why this is the product you want in your bag.

1. A market ready to switch. Finance teams are stuck between rigid legacy planning tools that need a rebuild every time the business changes, and spreadsheets and AI tools no one can trust. Abacum is the governed, AI-native foundation that fixes both. That's a displacement story you can tell in every account.

2. AI that stands up to a CFO. Plenty of vendors claim AI. Ours runs on a governed financial model, so the AI reasons and the math stays exact. CFOs and IT teams can trust the output, and that wins technical evaluations.

3. Faster time to value than legacy EPM. 700+ integrations and self-service data pipelines mean customers see value in weeks, not after a long implementation. That shortens your cycle and makes the business case easy to sign.

4. Channels that bring you deals. Abacum is the only FP&A platform to pass NetSuite's SuiteCloud Developer Network review, is listed on the Sage Intacct Marketplace, and is a verified Microsoft Dynamics 365 partner. Those ecosystems and our implementation partners mean co-sell pipeline, not just cold outbound.

5. A product that keeps getting stronger. New AI skills ship every week. Abacum works where finance already works: Excel, Slack, Claude and ChatGPT, through MCP-native infrastructure. You'll have something new to show every quarter.

6. Funded to win enterprise. Abacum raised a $60M Series B to scale into larger customers. You'll join as we build the enterprise motion, with the room to shape it and grow with it.

What you get

- Competitive base, uncapped commission, and equity

- Remote in EMEA, with hubs in New York, Toronto and Barcelona

- Direct access to leadership and a real say in how we sell to enterprise

Benefits

Customer Obsession: We share the understanding that Abacum's sole purpose is to create value for customers and relentlessly deploy all creativity and energy to that end.

Audacious Ambition: We dream big and embrace discomfort. We assume risks, make on-time mistakes and learn how to methodically accomplish our goals.

Good People: We are self-reflective and praise diversity of thought. We don't justify the end with the means and know where to draw the line. We have fun every day.

PAIR Finance denkt Inkasso neu: Wir entwickeln die fortschrittlichste KI-Technologie im Forderungsmanagement und haben damit die gesamte Inkassoindustrie nachhaltig verändert. jobs.title: Senior Risk Management Specialist (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

Your Mission

As Senior Risk Management Specialist, you will help scale and further develop lemon.markets’ Risk Management Framework in a period of growing regulatory expectations, business complexity, and organisational maturity. Sitting within the Risk team and working closely with the Head of Risk, you will take over meaningful responsibilities across multiple risk domains and help ensure our controls, assessments, and governance evolve with the company. Over the next 6 to 12 months, your focus will be on strengthening risk processes across operational and non-financial risk topics, contributing to financial risk topics such as ICAAP and ILAAP, and improving the structure, transparency, and efficiency of our risk tooling and reporting. This role matters because strong, pragmatic risk management is a core enabler of scalable growth in a regulated Brokerage-as-a-Service business. You will work across Product, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, and other stakeholders to turn regulatory and risk requirements into practical, tech-enabled solutions that reduce manual work and improve decision-making. It is a strong opportunity for someone who combines broad risk knowledge with a hands-on mindset and wants to help build a mature framework in a fast-moving environment.

In this role you will:

  • Own the identification, assessment, and documentation of risks across key domains together with the Risk team, business stakeholders, and control owners, so lemon.markets can make informed decisions and maintain a resilient risk profile as the business grows.

  • Drive risk assessments, control testing, and issue remediation tracking with teams across Product, Engineering, Operations, and Compliance, so we can detect weaknesses early, strengthen controls, and follow through on corrective actions.

  • Maintain and improve our internal control framework, risk register, and operational risk procedures in close collaboration with the Head of Risk and cross-functional stakeholders, so our framework remains effective, usable, and aligned with business and regulatory needs.

  • Contribute to risk topics across operational and non-financial risk, financial risk, ICAAP, ILAAP, third-party risk, and security-related assessments, so we can build a broader and more integrated view of risk across the organisation.

  • Draft clear business and technical requirements for process improvements, tooling enhancements, and automation initiatives with Product, Engineering, and Operations, so we can increase risk transparency, improve reporting quality, and reduce manual work.

  • Collaborate with auditors, supervisory stakeholders, and internal teams on evidence gathering, incident analysis, root-cause identification, and follow-up actions, so lemon.markets stays audit-ready and continues to improve the effectiveness of its risk management practices.


You’ll be successful in this role if you:

  • You bring strong hands-on experience in Risk Management within FinTech, banking, audit, consulting, or a similarly regulated environment, with broad exposure across multiple risk domains.

  • You have solid knowledge of operational and non-financial risk, internal controls, risk governance, and risk assessments, plus a good understanding of financial risk topics such as credit, market, liquidity, ICAAP, and ILAAP.

  • You are familiar with the relevant regulatory foundations, including MaRisk, DORA, CRR, IFR, and applicable EBA and ESMA guidelines; knowledge of MiFID, MaComp, and WpHG is a strong plus.

  • You are confident working with risk management tools, structured documentation, reporting, testing, and validation, and you are comfortable translating requirements into pragmatic process or tooling improvements.

  • You communicate clearly in English, and bring professional working proficiency in German to navigate regulatory documents and stakeholder communication in a German market context.

  • You are hands-on, analytical, and collaborative: you enjoy building, improving, and following through, work well across functions, and stay effective in fast-moving or sometimes ambiguous environments.


How we take care of you

  • 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets.

  • 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

  • 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributor lemoneers work 4 days or more and leadership lemoneers work 7 days or more per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites, or over team dinners.

  • 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations, as well as an annual learning budget.

  • 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like Polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day and our monthly new-joiner breakfasts. But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate.

  • 💛 Perks & benefits: We choose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing.

  • 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total.

As an equal opportunity employer, lemon.markets is committed to building an inclusive workplace. The company welcomes people from all different backgrounds, including age, citizenship, ethnic and racial origins, gender identities, individuals with disabilities, marital status, religions and ideologies, and sexual orientations to apply.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer | AI & Security
jobs.description:
Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Product & Platform) • Paris Office

  • Location: Paris (75002), 2 days remote per week

  • Company: Escape : Leading AI Cybersecurity

  • Compensation: €75–90k base + 0.05% BSPCE depending on seniority and scope

  • Total Engineering Team at Escape: 21 Engineers, 4 Technical Leads, 4 Squads

About Escape

Escape is offensive security for the teams that are 100x outnumbered. We build AI agents that find and exploit vulnerabilities in modern applications, APIs, and microservices: the way a real attacker would, but at the speed of a CI pipeline.

We're a Y Combinator W23 company. We just closed an $18M Series A in March 2026 led by Balderton Capital (with Uncorrelated Ventures, IRIS, and YC following on). Our customers and partners include Zoom, Schibsted, Wiz, Pandadoc, and a growing list of teams who've stopped pretending annual pen tests are enough. We're 40 people split between Paris and NYC, scaling to 80 in the next 12 months.

The product surface is real: ASM, business-logic-aware DAST, and AI Pentesting GA-ing this year. The competitive thesis is that LLMs collapsed the cost of offensive engineering by 1000x, and the companies that ship that capability into production first will own the next decade of the category. We're betting we're those companies.

About the Role

In AI, context is the moat. At Escape, the data model is the context: and a team of three owns it end to end.

Every Escape product (ASM, DAST, AI Pentesting) is built on top of one data model rich enough to represent an entire attack surface and everything our agents learn about it. That model is our moat, and this team owns it. You'll own the schema at the heart of the company and the last mile that delivers our offensive R&D to customers through the GraphQL API and the product UI. If it ships to a customer, it goes through your team.

This is not a CRUD SaaS role in security clothing. It's the highest-leverage seat in product engineering: small team, central surface, and a direct line from your commits to what a CISO sees. "Senior" here means you set technical direction, not just execute it.

What You'll Do

  • Own the data model that is the moat: Design and evolve the schema representing tens of thousands of assets, millions of findings, multi-identity context, and everything our AI accumulates across engagements. This compounds: get it right and the whole platform gets stronger.

  • Turn R&D into Product for customers: Turn the output of our offensive AI research into something teams actually use: through the Svelte frontend, the GraphQL API, integrations, and real-time data refresh. You're the bridge between technology and value.

  • Push PostgreSQL to its edge: Query optimization, index design, pagination, caching, low-latency search over millions of records. The platform is intensely data-driven and the standard playbook runs out fast. This is most of the job.

  • Build AI-native workflows: Guided triage, assisted remediation, signal extraction from noisy scan data. AI is woven through the product, not bolted on: you build the surfaces where it meets the user.

  • Drive architecture: Data modeling, system design, GraphQL schema. You decide how we build, not just what: with a real, un-gimmicky path to Tech Lead.

Our Tech Stack & Focus

Frontend: Svelte + TypeScript, GraphQL client Backend: Node.js, GraphQL (Yoga + Pothos), Prisma, PostgreSQL, Kafka Infra: AWS, GitLab CI, Grafana Adjacent deep tech: Python (AI/ML), Go (network tooling)

Perks & Benefits

  • 💸 Significant equity (Stock Options/BSPCE) – become a core stakeholder in Escape's journey

  • ❤️‍🩹 Top-tier health insurance with Alan

  • 🍕 Meal vouchers with Swile

  • 💪 EGYM Wellpass sport subscription

  • 📚 Continuous learning: budgets for books and online courses

  • 💻 Premium equipment to support your work

  • 🎁 Dedicated time for open-source projects

  • 🌍 Present at top international conferences (RSAC, BlackHat, DEFCON, BSides, APIDays)

About You

  • 5+ years building production web apps, genuinely strong on both frontend and backend

  • Deep TypeScript knowledge: you use the type system to its full potential, you don't just tolerate it

  • Proven experience designing (not just consuming) GraphQL schemas A real passion for product, craft, and design: you care how it feels, not only whether it works

jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will build the Command Centre, the screen an operator uses to see what our robots and cameras see, decide in seconds, and task the fleet. Soldiers have already run our console unaided after a short introduction. Next, one operator watches many sites, and tasks robots in plain language instead of drawing routes. That needs an interface built for it.

This role is engineering and design in one. You will shape the flows, prototype them, test them with operators, and ship them in production code, working with our full-stack engineer on the backend and our vision engineers on what the models show.

What You'll Work On

  • Operator interface: live video, site maps, robot positions and alerts in one view that works at 03:00.

  • Alert triage: the flow from alert to decision: evidence, context, confirm or dismiss, dispatch a robot.

  • Tasking by instruction: an interface for telling the fleet what to do in plain language, and seeing how it plans to do it.

  • Design system: components and patterns that keep the product consistent as it grows.

  • Usability: prototype, test with operators, measure, iterate.

  • Performance: real-time streams and many sites without the interface slowing down.

Who We're Looking For

Your Background

  • 3+ years of frontend engineering with TypeScript and React.

ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity


As a Supplier Quality Engineer, you will own supplier quality for a portfolio of critical mechanical, electrical and mechatronic suppliers, from supplier qualification through production and continuous improvement.

The role exists to strengthen our supplier quality processes as ANYbotics scales production and introduces new products. You will work closely with Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, and will spend time directly with suppliers to solve quality issues at the source.

This is a hands-on role: you will not only define processes and requirements, but also audit suppliers, drive corrective actions and make sure improvements are implemented and sustained.


Your Impact

Your Impact

  • Define supplier qualification criteria and establish robust processes for assessing and approving new suppliers.

  • Prepare and maintain supplier audit and assessment frameworks, including questionnaires and checklists.

  • Conduct on-site assessments of critical suppliers and drive audit findings through to closure.

  • Monitor supplier performance, identify recurring quality issues and initiate improvement or development actions where needed.

  • Identify suppliers, manufacturers and service providers requiring Quality Assurance Agreements (QAAs).

  • Develop and maintain QAA templates aligned with ISO 9001 and ISO 80079-34 requirements.

  • Review and negotiate QAA terms with suppliers, covering responsibilities, control points, traceability, non-conformities and other quality requirements.

  • Coordinate internal Quality, Legal and Purchasing approvals for QAAs and monitor ongoing supplier compliance.

  • Define and maintain the supplier NCR process, from detection and reporting through escalation, follow-up and closure.

  • Establish effective NCR templates and tracking tools, and communicate non-conformities clearly with suppliers.

  • Analyse NCR trends and recurring issues to identify systemic quality problems and drive corrective actions.

  • Initiate supplier development, improvement plans or requalification where supplier performance falls below expectations.


Your Profile

  • 5 years  experience in supplier quality management with complex mechatronic product

  • Hands-on experience conducting supplier audits and driving corrective actions through to verified closure.

  • Strong understanding of root-cause analysis, 8D  and structured problem solving.

  • Experience defining and negotiating supplier quality requirements, ideally including Quality Assurance Agreements.

  • Ability to work effectively across Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, while challenging suppliers when quality or delivery requirements are not met.

  • Willingness to travel to suppliers and spend time on-site when required.


Bonus Points
  • Experience with ISO 9001 and/or ISO 80079-34, particularly in an industrial or manufacturing environment.
  • Experience building or improving supplier quality processes in a scaling manufacturing organization.
  • Familiarity with statistical quality tools such as SPC, Cpk/Ppk and Pareto analysis.

    • What We Offer

    • The opportunity to own supplier quality for a portfolio of components directly contributing to the production of autonomous mobile robots.

    • Direct collaboration with Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing and Quality teams in Zurich and with suppliers internationally.

    • The opportunity to build and improve supplier quality processes as ANYbotics scales its production and product portfolio.

    We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.

Direkt verbunden mit dem Strommarkt – in Echtzeit, vollautomatisiert. So wird Energie dann genutzt, wenn sie erneuerbar verfügbar und besonders günstig ist. Bis 2030 wollen wir 1,5 Millionen Haushalte auf erneuerbare Energien umstellen. Über 3.000 Menschen arbeiten jeden Tag daran, an mehr als 80 Standorten weltweit, von Finnland bis Australien. 

Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen und Lösungen bauen, die wirklich zählen? Bewirb dich jetzt und gestalte mit uns die Energiewelt von morgen.

  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Du packst Projekte proaktiv an, arbeitest lösungsorientiert und behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Tasks den Überblick. Strategischem Wandel (AI Movement) gegenüber bist du besonders resilient.

jobs.title: Staff Product Designer
